Order to Invoice management: Transforming the Global Supply Chain Vision, Guiding Principles and Strategic Objectives into efficient and effective business processes to meet customer service levels and company objectives.

Order Management & Fulfillment Optimization

End-to-End Order Management: Oversee the entire order cycle, from order receipt through to shipment and delivery. Ensure all orders are processed efficiently and meet customer service levels and company objectives.

Order Prioritization & Coordination: Prioritize orders based on urgency, customer requirements, and service level agreements (SLAs), coordinating with Sales, Warehouse, and Logistics teams to ensure timely fulfillment.

Inventory Management: Collaborate with Regional Distribution teams to ensure optimal stock levels, availability, and effective allocation for order fulfillment, minimizing stockouts and backorders. Work closely with warehouse team lead to manage inventory and provide information proactively to management regarding slow moving stock.

Shipping & Delivery Optimization: Collaborate with Distribution and Transportation team to continuously monitor and optimize shipping methods, routes, and carriers to ensure cost-effective delivery while meeting or exceeding delivery targets.

Returns & Claims Management: Oversee processes related to returns, exchanges, and claims, ensuring smooth handling of damaged goods and addressing customer concerns efficiently.

Customer Communication & Support

Customer Interaction: Serve as the main point of contact for customer inquiries related to orders, shipping information, and fulfillment issues. Provide proactive updates to customers regarding order status, delays, or changes.

Issue Resolution: Effectively address and resolve any order-related issues or complaints, ensuring customer satisfaction and maintaining strong customer relationships following the case management process in order to enable customer centric development of the customer care organization.

Customer Experience: Work to enhance the customer experience by ensuring all touchpoints, from order placement to delivery, are seamless, transparent, and aligned with customer expectations.

Performance Tracking, KPIs & Continuous Improvement

KPIs: Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to track the performance of order management and fulfillment processes. Metrics include OTIF (On -time in full) via the GSC established Dashboard, order accuracy (monitored via non-productive orders), shipping costs, customer satisfaction, and return rates (Evaluated via the case management process). Monitor cost/order metrics and work to reduce fulfillment costs while maintaining performance.

Reporting & Analysis: Prepare and present reports on key metrics, fulfillment performance, cost savings, and operational challenges. Provide actionable insights to senior management for further optimization.

Continuous Improvement: Strive for operational Excellence by leading initiatives to identify process inefficiencies and drive improvements in order management workflows, inventory allocation, and fulfillment processes.

Cost Optimization: Identify cost-saving opportunities in the fulfillment and shipping processes without compromising on service quality. Monitor cost-per-order metrics and work to reduce fulfillment costs while maintaining performance.

People Management & Development

Leadership & Team Development: Lead, motivate, and develop high-performance teams. Foster a productive and engaged workforce by providing guidance, support, and career development opportunities.

Training & Development: Understand the strengths and areas for improvement of the current team and identify any training or resources they may need.

Performance Management: Set clear expectations and goals for team members, conduct mid-year and end of year performance reviews (by March 31st), provide constructive feedback, and identify areas for development. Create individualized plans to support employee growth and retention.

Quality and Regulatory Compliance Adhere to quality system procedures in accordance with the local regulations or requirements

Your Expertise

Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Economics, Science or related subject is must.

5-7 years’ professional experience in the field of sales support, order management, logistics, supply chain or equivalent combination of education and work experience

Life science industry experience is considered an advantage

Proven experience in order management, CRM platforms, and preparing customer quotations

Solid working knowledge of SAP

Background in coordinating and managing projects

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel

Strong customer‑centric mindset

Excellent verbal and written communication abilities

Capacity to handle multiple tasks and perform well under pressure

Exceptional organizational and time‑management skills

Collaborative team-oriented approach

Your Benefits at Eppendorf

We truly appreciate our employees and their performance.

We offer a wide range of learning and development opportunities to allow you to deepen your technical knowledge and for continuous growth.

By working with us, you will make a meaningful contribution to improving human living conditions.

Attractive salary, employee benefits and performance bonus.

Eppendorf is an equal opportunity employer. We offer all qualified employees and applicants identical chances.

title: Manager - Legal
description:
Role Overview

This role supports the legal function of a global semiconductor organization, focusing on drafting and negotiating complex commercial agreements across the supply chain – from foundry services and IP licensing to customer sales and strategic partnerships. The candidate will also support corporate transactions and partnerships, oversee compliance with export control regimes and manage intellectual property risks across jurisdictions. The role further involves independently providing day-to-day legal advisory support to internal stakeholders on commercial, regulatory, and compliance issues impacting company’s operations.

Core Responsibilities

 Contract Drafting & Negotiation 

Leading end-to-end drafting, structuring, review, and negotiation of a wide range of commercial contracts, including - NDAs, MSAs, collaboration agreements, joint venture agreement,, licensing and technology contracts, supply chain contracts (such as contracts with foundry and fabricators), customer contracts, channel partner agreements/ distributor agreements, leave and license agreements, lease deeds, employee contracts and other need based transaction documents 

Ensure alignment with business objectives while minimizing legal exposure

Provide legal guidance during contract negotiations and escalations

Support the development and maintenance of contract templates, negotiation playbooks, and legal process workflows and update the contract templates from time to time keeping in view the latest developments in the law and to address the issues being faced from time to time and to mitigate the risks

Drafting and vetting of notices to be sent to vendors/channel partner/ for any breach of contractual provisions/ enforcing any contractual rights like risk purchase clauses etc drafting and vetting of replies to notices received from the vendors, customers, governmental agencies and effectively handle potential litigation/potential arbitration matters.

 Stakeholder Collaboration 

Partner with internal teams such as Sales, Procurement, Finance, and Operations to structure deals and resolve contractual issues

Conduct internal training sessions on contract best practices, IP awareness, and compliance protocols etc. 

Provide day-to-day legal advisory support on a broad range of operational, commercial, regulatory, and compliance matters, ensuring timely and practical business solutions

Develop toolkits, checklists, and guidance notes to strengthen business teams’ contracting capabilities

Co-ordinate with External Law Firms and brief the Couse, , where the Company engages Law Firms/ Counsel in critical truncations and/or merger and acquisitions

 Intellectual Property Strategy 

Advise on IP ownership, licensing, and protection for chip designs, firmware, and proprietary manufacturing processes

Review and structure IP provisions in collaboration and development contracts to ensure alignment with the company’s IP strategy

Coordinate with R&D and external counsel on patent filings and trade secret management

 Export Controls & Trade Compliance 

Ensure compliance with global export control laws (e.g., EAR, ITAR, Wassenaar Arrangement)

Support the classification of semiconductor products and technologies

Liaise with internal teams to manage licensing, embargoes, and sanctions risks

 Cross-Border Legal Advisory 

Interpret and apply international legal frameworks (e.g., DTAA, GDPR, local IP laws) across jurisdictions such as US, Japan, India, Germany, and other key markets.

Support M&A, joint ventures, and strategic alliances with legal due diligence and contract structuring.

Interact with external law firms where Company engages such Law Firms.

 Governance & Risk Mitigation 

Maintain legal templates and playbooks

Assist the stakeholders in governance initiatives 

Contract management 

 Legal research and Legal Opinion 

Conduct in‑depth legal research on statutes, regulations, case law and statutory and regulatory developments relevant to the company’s operations, products and contracts, including in the areas of contract law, intellectual property, technology and data

Render Legal opinion after analyzing the contractual provisions, statutory and regulatory provisions and latest case laws and highlight the risks and suggest mitigation measures.

Ideal Profile

LL.B. or equivalent legal qualification; candidates with LL.M. are encouraged to apply 

7–8 years of PQE, preferably with a mix of law firm and in-house experience 

Excellent negotiation, drafting, and stakeholder management skills 

Proven track record of leading complex commercial and technology transactions 

Strong grasp of IP law, export controls, and international contracting

Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and influence decision-making in a fast-paced, global environment

Experience in semiconductor, electronics, or high-technology sector preferred

The Candidate shall independently handle the matters specified above and also guide and train the sub-ordinates.

title: Associate Director - Legal (M&A )

Job Description

Flipkart’s Legal, M&A and Corporate Strategy practice group is responsible for all mergers & acquisitions, corporate restructuring, venture capital activity, partnership structuring, fund raises, Group ESOP advisories, strategic business initiatives, being subject-matter experts on various aspects of regulations impacting our industry as well as supporting our Compliance function on specific regulatory matters. We are looking for a seasoned legal professional who will act as a strategic partner to the corporate development team, business leaders, the broader legal function, corporate functions and outside counsel to lead M&A transactions and provide managerial guidance on the other areas included within the practice group.

We are looking for someone who will lead complex domestic and cross-border transactions, manage strategic investments, and oversee corporate governance and advisory matters that shape the future of the Flipkart ecosystem. This individual needs to have a high degree of judgment and the ability to see the big picture. The ideal candidate will be a self-starter and be able to effectively interact with a fair but demanding client base.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities:

Transaction Management: Lead the end-to-end legal lifecycle for M&A, joint ventures, and strategic investments. This includes structuring deals, conducting/managing due diligence, and drafting/negotiating definitive agreements (SHA, SSA, SPA, BTA, Commercial / Strategic Agreements).

Fundraising & Capital Markets: Support the leadership team in capital raising initiatives, managing relationships with external investors, and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements during funding rounds.

ESOP & Employee Incentives: Provide expert advisory on ESOP structuring, grant cycles, liquidations, and the legal implications of employee incentive schemes across various jurisdictions.

General Corporate Advisory: Act as a subject matter expert on the Companies Act, FEMA (FDI/ODI guidelines), SEBI regulations, and other general corporate laws.

Strategic Advisory: Partner with business stakeholders to provide commercially-viable legal solutions for new business initiatives and restructuring exercises.

External Counsel Management: Strategically select and manage top-tier domestic and international law firms to ensure high-quality, cost-effective legal support.

Qualifications & Skills:

Must-Haves:

Experience: A minimum of 8 years of post-qualification experience (PQE).

Law-Firm Experience: At least 5 years of experience working within the M&A/Corporate practice of a leading Tier-1 law firm.

Education: LL.B. from a reputed national or international law school. LLM or Company Secretary will be considered a benefit, but not compulsory

Subject Matter Expertise: Deep technical knowledge of Indian corporate law, FEMA, cross-border M&A frameworks, and investment regulations.

Preferred Attributes:

Tech/E-commerce Exposure: Prior experience in the technology, retail, or e-commerce sectors is a significant plus.

Negotiation Skills: Ability to navigate complex, multi-party negotiations with a solution-oriented mindset.

Communication (oral and written): Exceptional oratory and drafting skills and the ability to simplify complex legal risks for non-legal business leaders.

Leadership: Proven track record of mentoring junior counsel and managing cross-functional projects.

Culture: Demonstrated commitment and contribution to fostering and advancing equity, diversity and inclusion. 

Inter-personal skills & Teamwork: Ability to work harmoniously and effectively within the team, as well as with multiple cross-functional teams. 

Integrity: High professional integrity and ethical standards, with a strong commitment to legal ethics exhibited in knowledge and practice, and professional responsibility.

Why Flipkart?

You will be at the forefront of India’s digital revolution. This role offers the unique opportunity to work on some of the largest and most complex transactions, as well as getting to know the Indian startup ecosystem from inside out, providing a platform for immense professional growth and impact.

Note: This role requires a candidate who thrives in a fast-paced environment and possesses the "founder's mindset" to take end-to-end ownership of legal workstreams.

title: Legal Counsel - Dispute Resolution

Job Summary:

Act as in-house dispute resolution counsel for pre-litigation strategy, notices, litigation, arbitration, consumer matters, regulatory proceedings, enforcement actions, settlements, and related advisory. The role requires close coordination with business, operations, customer support, human resources, finance, compliance, real estate, and external counsels to drive timely, practical, and commercially aligned outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

● Manage end-to-end disputes across civil, commercial, consumer, criminal, labour, real estate, recovery, and regulatory matters, including strategy, documentation, internal coordination, and follow-through.

● Draft, review, and finalise legal notices, replies, demand and recovery letters, cease and desist communications, complaints, written statements, affidavits, applications, petitions, appeals, and settlement documents.

● Work with and manage external counsels across litigation, arbitration, mediation, conciliation, and other proceedings, including briefing, pleadings review, hearing preparation, and progress monitoring.

● Coordinate with internal teams and external counsels for appearances and actions before courts, tribunals, consumer commissions, police, investigative and enforcement authorities, quasi-judicial forums, and other government or regulatory bodies.

● Advise internal stakeholders on dispute prevention, escalation handling, documentation standards, evidence creation and preservation, and customer, vendor, landlord, franchisee, employee, and operational issues with legal exposure.

● Support high-risk complaints and contentious matters, including franchisee, landlord and property disputes, cheque bounce and recovery matters, employee-related issues, frauds, and contractual breaches.

● Maintain efficient dispute processes, including intake, case tracking, hearing calendars, evidence collation, status reporting, repository management, exposure assessment, settlement status, and closure of matters.

● Conduct legal research on applicable laws, case law, and procedural or regulatory developments, and provide practical dispute-related advice to the business.

● Drive resolution strategies, including negotiation and settlement, balancing legal risk, precedent value, business continuity, and reputational considerations.

● Coordinate with finance and business teams on provisioning inputs, recovery and enforcement steps, payment disputes, and implementation of settlement terms or court / tribunal orders.

● Support management reporting on material matters, dispute trends, financial exposure, root causes, and preventive actions.

● Support such other contentious and advisory matters as may be assigned from time to time.

Candidate Profile:

● Strong grounding in dispute resolution, procedural law, evidence, pleadings, and case strategy.

● Ability to independently handle matters while partnering closely with business teams on sensitive or high-stakes disputes.

● Strong drafting, research, analytical, stakeholder management, and external counsel management skills.

● Comfortable working in a fast-paced, business-facing in-house environment.

Preferred Qualification/ Experience:

● LL.B. from a recognised university

● 8-10 years of post-qualification experience in dispute resolution / litigation

● Strong in-house and/or law firm experience in consumer, retail, real estate, operational, or commercial disputes

Ensure preventive and corrective maintenance programs are implemented to maintain operational reliability and equipment availability.

Drive the standardization of work procedures, technical instructions, and safety practices across all operational sites.

Support continuous improvement initiatives to increase productivity, reduce operational costs, and improve service quality.

Ensure operational resources (manpower, equipment, tooling) are effectively allocated to meet customer demand and project timelines.

Ensure close coordination with production, logistics, and supply chain teams to meet delivery commitments.

Resolve customer escalations and operational challenges in collaboration with sales and technical teams.

Enhance the use of ERP and CRM systems to ensure data accuracy and operational efficiency.

Align market demand with production capacity, site capabilities, and inventory levels.

Sales and Key Account teams with commercial intelligence, contract interpretation, and risk assessments.

Make decisions regarding delivery prioritization or delivery suspension in case of payment delays.

Sales teams

Site operations

Production and supply chain

Engineering and product development

Finance and credit control

title: Front Risk Manager
description:
At a Glance: The Story Behind AMINA

Founded in April 2018 and headquartered in Zug, AMINA Bank is a pioneer in the financial industry. In August 2019, AMINA received a Swiss banking and securities dealer license from FINMA. The broad, vertically integrated spectrum of services, combined with the highest security standards, make AMINA’s value proposition unique. AMINA operates globally from its regulated hubs in Switzerland, Abu Dhabi, and Hong Kong to offer fiat and crypto services to progressive investors, traditional and crypto-native alike, whether individuals, corporates, or institutions.

CVVC Global Report and CB Insights named AMINA as one of the Top 50 Companies within the blockchain ecosystem. Aite Group awarded AMINA their 2021 Digital Wealth Management Impact Innovation Award in the ‘Digital Startup of the Year’ category, and LinkedIn listed AMINA as one of the Top Startups 2021 in Switzerland. In 2022, AMINA won the Digital Assets Offering or Service at the WealthBriefing Swiss EAM Awards, and the bank was also recognised for its product offering SEBAX and won the Best ETP of the Year award at the Swiss ETF Awards 2022. In 2023, AMINA won the European WealthBriefing Award in the Digital Assets Solution, Fund Manager category.

AMINA India is a wholly owned subsidiary of AMINA Bank AG. AMINA India acts as a virtual extension of the bank supporting activities spanning trading & liquidity management, digital assets research, marketing, investment solutions, risk management, account management, mid/back-office, product management, technology & engineering, IT support, finance and human resources.

Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It)

As a Front Risk Manager, you will be the first line of defense in safeguarding the bank's operations by proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks associated with our front-office activities. This role is pivotal in ensuring that our trading, sales, and client-facing operations align with regulatory requirements and the bank’s risk appetite. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams, providing insights and strategies to manage risks effectively while enabling the business to grow sustainably.

Your AMINA To-Do List

Client Lifecycle Support:

Advise Relationship Managers throughout the entire client lifecycle, including onboarding, periodic reviews and offboarding

Serve as an effective interface between the First and Second Lines of Defense and smoothing collaboration between the two

Serve as point of contact for general risk-related queries, KYC, AML, CDB20, SARs, Cross Border,etc

Act as a sparring partner to Relationship Managers for complex relationships and/or cases presented to the Onboarding Committee

Participate in client calls to address Compliance matters

Collaborate constructively with Compliance on risk matters, projects or initiatives – confidently taking ownership and leading where required

Develop and deliver tailor-made trainings

First Line of Defense (1LoD) Controls:

Execute 1LoD controls in accordance with the applicable control plan, particularly in areas such as AML/KYC and transaction monitoring and manage follow-up measures to address identified risks.

Risk Identification & Mitigation:

Analyze and evaluate risks across front-office activities, including trading, sales, and client onboarding, while implementing effective risk controls to mitigate these risks.

Business Risk Framework:

Support the setup, operation, and maintenance of a robust front business risk management framework. Contribute to designing, formalizing, and implementing relevant front-office controls.

Process Improvements:

Participate in and/or lead projects and initiatives to improve front-to-back compliance processes, aligning them with regulatory standards and organizational goals.

Monitoring & Reporting:

Conduct ongoing monitoring of risk exposures, prepare comprehensive reports for senior management and regulatory authorities, and ensure timely escalation of critical issues.

Training & Awareness:

Develop and deliver front-office training and communication measures to enhance compliance awareness and promote a culture of risk management.

Collaboration & Coordination:

Act as a liaison between the front office and the second line of defense (2LoD), ensuring alignment on compliance and risk management practices and resolving escalations efficiently.

Your golden ticket to the AMINA team:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law, Finance, Risk Management, Economics, or a related field.

10+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance matters within a bank (AML, KYC, CDB20, Sanctions,etc)

Ability to draft documents that are for third-party readers to understand

Experienced in handling Relationship Managers with varying personalities and levels of seniority

Robust knowledge of digital assets is preferred

Chainalysis Reactor certified is a plus

Strong understanding of risk frameworks, regulatory standards, and trading practices

Proficient in data analysis, with experience using risk management tools and systems

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

Professional certifications such as ICA or ACAMS are highly desirable

Why We’re Awesome

We owe our exponential growth to our innovative and collaborate team spirit and talented workforce. Every voice counts as we are always committed to learning from diverse perspectives and backgrounds because our people make the difference at AMINA Bank.

Regardless of your age, gender, belief, and background, at AMINA EVERYONE is welcome! 

Join our skilled team and together redefine finance.

title: Python Developer Intern
description:
Job Description

Job Title: Full Stack Developer (Python & React) - 6-Month Internship (Freshers)

Level: Internship / Fresher

Location: Kharadi, Pune

Employment Type: Internship (6 months)

Stipend: 10,000 per month

About CargoFL

CargoFL is an AI-driven Logistics & Supply Chain SaaS platform that empowers businesses with smarter, data-driven solutions for transportation, warehousing, and supply chain operations.

Role Overview

We are looking for enthusiastic Full Stack Developer Interns (Python & React) — freshers seeking a 6-month, hands-on internship to learn and contribute to our SaaS platform. You will work on both backend services and frontend interfaces, gaining practical experience in building production-ready features.

Key Responsibilities

The high-level responsibilities below are supplemented with specific daily tasks, expected outputs, and the common tools/processes you will use while working with the team.

Primary Responsibilities

Develop and maintain backend services using Python (Django/Flask/FastAPI): implement RESTful APIs, database models, and migrations; optimize queries and ensure scalable designs.

Build responsive and user-friendly frontend interfaces using React: develop reusable components, manage state (Redux/Context), integrate with APIs, and ensure accessibility and responsive layouts.

Design and integrate APIs: collaborate on API contracts, document endpoints (Swagger/OpenAPI), and validate integrations using Postman or equivalent tools.

Write automated tests and ensure code quality: add unit and integration tests (pytest, unittest, Jest, React Testing Library), maintain test coverage, and use linters/type-checkers (flake8, ESLint, mypy/TypeScript).

Follow engineering processes: use Git workflows (feature branches, pull requests), participate in code reviews, and address review feedback promptly.

Participate in CI/CD and deployments: create and maintain CI pipelines (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Jenkins), build Docker images, and assist with staging deployments and basic monitoring.

Debug, monitor, and maintain applications: investigate issues using logs and error tracking (eg. Sentry), fix defects, and implement performance improvements.

Collaborate effectively: attend daily standups, sprint planning, and design discussions; work closely with product, QA, and other engineers to deliver features end-to-end.

Document work: update README, API docs, runbooks, and release notes for features you deliver.

Typical daily tasks

Morning standup: share progress, blockers, and daily plan.

Review and respond to code review comments; merge approved pull requests.

Implement new features or bug fixes: write code, unit tests, and update API docs.

Run local tests and push changes to remote branches; monitor CI results and fix any pipeline failures.

Integrate with teammates on API changes or frontend designs; pair-program when needed.

Deploy to staging (when part of release) and verify behavior; report issues for production rollout.

Expected outputs / success indicators

Feature-complete, reviewed, and merged pull requests with accompanying tests and documentation.

API endpoints that meet contract specifications and have automated tests.

Frontend components that are responsive, accessible, and covered by unit/visual tests.

CI pipelines that pass reliably and any introduced pipelines or deployment steps are documented.

Timely resolution of assigned bugs and clear communication of release readiness.

Active participation in team rituals and constructive contributions during code reviews.

Tools & processes you will use

Version control & code review: Git, GitHub/GitLab, pull requests and code reviews.

CI/CD & containerization: GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Jenkins, Docker (Kubernetes knowledge helpful but not required).

Testing & quality: pytest, unittest, Jest, React Testing Library, ESLint, flake8, mypy/TypeScript.

API & debugging: Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, SQL clients, logging, and error-tracking tools (Sentry or equivalent).

Issue tracking & collaboration: Jira/Trello, Confluence, Slack, and regular agile ceremonies.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field — or currently pursuing one.

Experience level: Freshers or 0-1 years of practical experience (internships, academic projects or hobby projects welcome).

Strong fundamentals in Python and familiarity with at least one web framework (Django, Flask or FastAPI).

Basic understanding of React.js and front-end development, including HTML5 and CSS3 for responsive layouts.

Familiarity with databases (SQL and/or NoSQL) and writing basic queries.

Comfortable using version control (Git) and collaboration platforms (GitHub/GitLab) with feature-branch workflows and pull requests.

Familiarity with writing and running unit/integration tests (pytest, unittest, Jest, React Testing Library) and using linters (flake8, ESLint).

Comfortable working with RESTful APIs and tools like Postman or Swagger/OpenAPI for validation and documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on internship experience or academic projects involving React state management (Redux or Context API).

Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and tools (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) and basic Docker usage.

Awareness of basic cloud concepts (AWS/GCP/Azure) — deploying services, storage, or using managed databases is a plus.

Exposure to type checking and static analysis tools (mypy, TypeScript) and error-monitoring tools (Sentry).

Understanding of agile development practices, issue trackers (Jira/Trello), and participation in code reviews.

Strong problem-solving skills, good communication, and eagerness to learn full-stack development best practices.

Compensation & Logistics

Stipend: ₹10,000 per month.

Expected weekly hours: 25–30 hours per week (part-time internship), typically spread across 4–5 working days. Exact schedule is flexible and will be agreed upon during onboarding.

Work schedule: Hybrid model — typically 3 days in-office at our Kharadi, Pune location and 2 days remote. We offer flexible start times with core hours from 11:00–16:00 IST.

How to Apply & Interview Process

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis — apply as soon as possible. If you have a specific availability window, mention it in your email.

Interview steps (typical)

Resume screening: Initial review by the hiring team (1 week).

Screening call (15–30 min): A short conversation with a recruiter/hiring manager to discuss background, interest, and logistics (weekly hours, start date, location).

Technical assignment (take-home): A short practical assignment or coding task to be completed within 3–5 days. This helps us evaluate coding style, problem-solving, and approach to real-world tasks.

Technical interview (45–60 min): Live coding and discussion of the take-home assignment, algorithms, and fundamentals (data structures, Python, React basics).

Team/Manager interview (30–45 min): Discussion around role fit, collaboration, and expectations. May include brief system-design or architecture conversation relevant to the internship level.

Final HR discussion & offer: If all rounds are successful, we will discuss offer details, start date, and onboarding logistics. Typical process duration: 2–3 weeks end-to-end (may vary).

If you need any accommodation during the interview process, please mention this in your application email.

What We Offer

Hands-on training in full-stack development (Python + React).

Exposure to SaaS, AI, and supply chain domain.

Opportunity for full-time role based on performance.

We do this by harnessing our collective expertise and passion to challenge what’s possible and drive extraordinary impact. We’re building a dynamic and collaborative workplace where new ideas are welcome.

Protecting 11,000+ customers against bad actors and threats means we’re continuing to push the envelope just like we’ ve been doing for the past 20 years. If you ’re ready to solve some of the toughest challenges in cybersecurity, we’re ready to help you take command of your career. Join us.

Our proposition

Role

We have a software + services proposition for the merchant with the goal of optimising for the merchant's profitability.Our product is an all-in-one software stack that gives merchants everything they need to sell D2C, i.e. Storefront, Shipping, Marketing integrations, Communication. title: District Operations Manager - Mid Americas
description:
Eaton’s ES AMER ESS division is currently seeking a District Operations Manager - Mid Americas.

The expected annual salary range for this role is $146000 - $215000 a year. This position is also eligible for a variable incentive program.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

What You’ll Do

Eaton’s Engineering Service & Systems division is hiring a District Operations Manager to lead our field services engineering team in Southern Ohio & Indiana. This position can be based out of our Westerville, OH, West Chester, OH, or Indianapolis, IN site and is subject to 25% travel. The District Operations Manager is responsible for managing the day-to-day field service business and associated personnel. In addition, this position will support the regional sales organization in growing regional markets through control of price and with an emphasis on value and service to the customer.

Eaton has the largest and most experienced team of field services representatives in the industry. This team brings extensive skills and experiences to field service engineering. Active participation in recognized technical societies such as NFPA and IEEE and collaboration with a variety of utilities and industries ensures that our representatives are knowledgeable about today’s cutting-edge technology and engineering techniques. We assist customers at every stage of the power system: offering start-up and commissioning of equipment, performing planned maintenance, monitoring performance, diagnosing system problems remotely, as well as responding to emergencies on a 24/7 basis, 365 days a year. Our support services help businesses make the most of their existing electrical equipment by optimizing performance and extending the life of existing facilities.

In this position you will;

Assure the safety of employees who work in low, medium, and high voltage work environments. Fosters and develops safety culture through field visits and coaching. Assures compliance with safety policies, assures safety equipment resources are available and properly tested, provides direction for proper disposal of hazardous and non-hazardous materials.

Effectively manage a team of diverse and dispersed field-based workforce throughout assigned territory. Demonstrates good corporate citizenship. Assures the security and effective allocation of company resources and assets.

Assure an effective and skilled staff is maintained through recruiting, assessment of talent (find gaps and follow action plans to fill gaps), training & development, goal setting, communications, performance appraisal, and conformance to applicable company policies and standards.

Act as a sales and marketing agent in conjunction with sales and operations management to ensure top-line sales and bottom-line profit objectives are met.

Develop and manage accurate yearly and monthly forecasts to deliver on quarterly and yearly financial commitments.

Responsible for driving operational excellence through service operations including, effective promotion and deployment of continuous improvement fundamentals, procurement and effective use of capital equipment for the territory, efficient execution of service orders, inventory management, managing receivables, and turn of backlog.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited institution

Minimum 7 years of experience in a service, sales or engineering role

Minimum 5 years of supervisory experience leading an operations, service, or engineering unit

Possess and maintain a valid and unrestricted driver’s license

Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc. Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% of the time

Relocation assistance will be provided to candidates outside a 50 mile radius of Indianapolis IN, West Chester OH, or Worthington OH 

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree with electrical focus

Master’s degree required from an accredited institution, preferably in electrical field

Knowledge and understanding of the Electrical Services industry, products and solutions.

Working knowledge of the overall sales function, customer channels to market, and negotiation techniques and must be able to manage division, customer and departmental resources to maximize growth opportunities.

Electrical Contractor’s license

Professional Engineering license

General Contractor’s license

Knowledge of power distribution, control products; as well as field service practices and procedures

We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

Eaton believes in second chance employment. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history will be considered regardless of their arrest or conviction history, consistent with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act and other local laws.

You do not need to disclose your conviction history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if Eaton is concerned about conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report.

To request a disability-related reasonable accommodation to assist you in your job search, application, or interview process, please call us at 1-800-836-6345 to discuss your specific need. Only accommodation requests will be accepted by this phone number.

We know that good benefit programs are important to employees and their families. Eaton provides various Health and Welfare benefits as well as Retirement benefits, and several programs that provide for paid and unpaid time away from work. Click here for more detail: Eaton Benefits Overview. Please note that specific programs and options available to an employee may depend on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

title: Operations Manager
description:
From commercial office space and manufacturing to multi-site retail portfolios, we manage and support over 1 billion square feet of facilities space for the nation’s leading organizations. We provide comprehensive facility services ranging from mechanical maintenance and self-performed, site-based operations to energy-efficiency upgrades and supplier-managed interior/exterior maintenance.

Job Summary

The Operations Manager acts as the primary strategic liaison and escalation point for Learning Care (LC) exterior and janitorial service lines. Responsible for overseeing the execution of national landscape, winter snow preparation and removal, and janitorial service contracts across all locations. Operating within a highly matrixed structure, this role partners heavily with our sister company, EMCOR USM, to drive performance, manage complex escalations, and ensure exceptional service delivery. This position requires a highly skilled communicator capable of evoking change without direct reporting authority, negotiating critical resolutions, and presenting forward-thinking business solutions to both internal stakeholders and client executive leadership

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

 Service Line Oversight: Oversees the execution and strategic performance of the national landscape, winter snow preparation/removal, and janitorial services contracts for the LCG portfolio to ensure service delivery meets and exceeds customer expectations 

 Matrix Leadership: Navigates a complex, matrixed organizational structure to partner effectively with the EMCOR USM team (including dedicated facility coordinators, supervisors, and managers). Drives operational excellence and evokes process changes among cross-functional team members without direct reporting authority 

 Escalation & Resolution: Serves as the primary point of escalation for complex exterior and janitorial service issues. Acts as the definitive liaison between the client, USM partners, and internal Facilities Managers to negotiate effective resolutions and mitigate operational risks 

 Executive Communication: Develops and delivers comprehensive business proposals, strategic updates, and performance metrics. Reports and presents confidently to internal stakeholders and customer audiences, frequently up to the C-suite level 

 Strategic Solutions & Relationship Building: Provides forward-thinking solutions and continuous improvement strategies for assigned service lines. Invokes strong confidence and trust with the client regarding the capability of these services to consistently support their schools 

Qualifications

 Bachelor’s degree in Facilities Management, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field preferred. OR In lieu of a degree, 8+ years of progressive, high-level experience in multi-site facilities, construction, or asset management will be considered 

 5+ years of specific experience in multi-site facilities or asset management, ideally within high-volume retail, education, or hospitality sectors 

 Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. Ability to write clear, persuasive business proposals and executive summaries. Ability to effectively negotiate, present information, and confidently respond to questions from client C-suite executives, internal management, and external service partners 

 Proficiency in standard business software and reporting tools required to build proposals and analyze service performance 

 Physical Demands 

 The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to stand, walk, sit, use hands to finger, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, talk, hear, taste or smell from 1/3 to 2/3 of the time. The employee must lift 1 to 50 pounds less than 1/3 of the time. Specific vision requirements for this job are close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision and depth perception 

 Work Environment 

 While performing the duties of this job, the employee will primarily operate in a remote, home-office setting where the noise level is usually quiet. Additionally, this position requires periodic travel (including commercial flights and driving) to various Learning Care Group schools to participate in physical site inspections. During these field visits, the employee may navigate active early education environments, mechanical rooms, and outdoor property areas subject to varying weather conditions 

 Equal Opportunity Employer 

As a leading provider of mechanical and electrical construction, facilities services, and energy infrastructure, we offer employees a competitive salary and benefits package and we are always looking for individuals with the talent and skills required to contribute to our continued growth and success. Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled

 Affirmative Action Policy 

Please review our Affirmative Action Policy .

 Notice to Prospective Employees 

Notice to prospective employees: There have been fraudulent postings and emails regarding job openings. EMCOR Group and its companies list open positions here . Please check our available positions to confirm that a post or email is genuine.

EMCOR Group and its companies do not reach out to individuals to help with marketing or other similar services. If an individual is contacted for services outside of EMCOR’s normal application process – it is probably fraudulent.

title: Operations Manager
description:
How will you make an impact?

The Operations Manager is responsible for leading day‑to‑day manufacturing operations at the CVG campus, driving execution, accountability, and continuous improvement across assigned work cells and functional leaders. This role partners closely with the Operations Director, Business Unit leadership, and support functions to deliver safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people objectives in a high‑mix, high‑volume manufacturing environment.

This leader sets the operational tone on the floor—balancing urgency with discipline—while building strong, capable management teams and scalable processes that support growth, customer commitments, and long‑term site stability.

What will you do?

Leadership & People Management

Recruit, develop, and retain high‑performing Functional Managers and Operations leaders aligned to CVG operational needs. 

Partner with Talent Acquisition to define clear capability requirements and selection criteria for management roles. 

Coach and mentor managers on leadership presence, decision‑making, performance management, and accountability. 

Proactively monitor turnover, engagement, and bench strength; identify risks and implement targeted retention and succession plans. 

Employee & Team Development

Assess individual and team capability gaps; ensure training plans and standard work are in place and effectively executed. 

Validate and continuously improve training curricula for operations leadership and frontline management. 

Build succession pipelines for critical leadership roles to support business continuity and growth. 

Foster a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and operational excellence. 

Performance Management & Execution

Establish clear, measurable goals aligned to site and Business Unit priorities (Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, Productivity, and People). 

Drive consistent use of operational metrics, dashboards, and tiered accountability reviews. 

Provide timely, direct feedback and coaching based on performance data and observed behaviors. 

Ensure performance evaluations are completed accurately, fairly, and on time. 

Lead teams through periods of change, escalation, or operational disruption while maintaining focus and discipline. 

Communication & Engagement

Ensure consistent, transparent communication across operations leadership and frontline teams. 

Create forums for two‑way communication, idea sharing, and problem‑solving. 

Recognize and reinforce strong performance in a fair and consistent manner. 

Adapt communication style to effectively engage diverse teams across shifts and functions. 

Business Strategy & Alignment

Align workcell execution with customer requirements, capacity plans, and financial targets. 

Provide regular updates to the Operations Director and Business Unit leadership on performance, risks, and improvement initiatives. 

Cost & Resource Management

Monitor cost trends and productivity metrics; ensure corrective actions are implemented when targets are missed. 

Partner with Finance, Engineering, and Quality to balance cost, quality, and delivery outcomes. 

Forecasting & Planning

Support accurate headcount, capacity, and production forecasting for the CVG campus. 

Analyze forecast vs. actual performance to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities. 

Technical & Operational Excellence

Drive continuous improvement through data‑driven analysis, KPI management, and structured problem‑solving (QRQC, RCA, Kaizen). 

Ensure standard work, procedures, and work instructions are effective, current, and consistently followed. 

Champion best‑in‑class manufacturing practices and share learnings across Jabil sites. 

Partner with Engineering and Quality to improve process capability, yield, and customer satisfaction. 

Ensure full compliance with all Jabil policies, including Safety, Quality, Security, and Confidentiality. 

Promote a strong safety culture and ensure adherence to all health and safety requirements.

Leadership background that is hands on - leads from the front, culture and change mgmt driver. 

Experience operating in a complex, matrix, fast‑paced manufacturing environment (EMS preferred).

Safety mindset.

title: Manager, Manufacturing Operations
description:
Company Overview

 Why Choose Us? 

Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging that supports multiple industries including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors. Novolex manufacturing and sourcing expertise spans a diverse range of substrates including resin, paper, molded fiber, aluminum and more. We provide customers a broad array of stock and customized solutions with 120 product categories, 250 brands and over 39,000 SKUs.

 Our Sustainability Commitment 

The Novolex sustainability vision is built upon three pillars: our products, our operations and our people. Each is critically important to our growth and future as a business. These pillars form the foundation of our company-wide commitment to sustainability, helping us achieve our ambitious goals through our wide-ranging initiatives.

Job Description

The Operations Manager is accountable for inspiring and executing strategies which achieve optimum safety, quality, service, productivity, and profitability. They will perpetuate the following responsibilities, either personally or, through subordinate supervisors and subordinate connections:

 Advance initiatives that promote and sustain the safety, health, security, and welfare of all employees. 

 Maintain safe, clean, orderly (5s), and environmentally compliant production operations. 

 Follow GMP in compliance with all food safety requirements and maintain a facility that is always ‘audit’ ready. 

 Inclusive oversight of all production and production support activities of the facility ensuring all are conducted in accordance with Company policies, principles, procedures, values, and standards. 

 Perpetually assess current strategies, systems, procedures, performance, capabilities, equipment, facilities, and employees for opportunities to optimize safety, flow, service, quality, and profitability. 

 Coordinates with Maintenance Manager, Process Engineers and Maintenance Planner to support a predictive and preventative maintenance program. 

 Provide technical recommendations and implementation for continuous improvement in plant production process. 

 Supervise the installation and repair of all machinery/equipment in conjunction with the day-to-day activities of maintenance technicians. 

 Execute supervisory responsibilities in accordance with all policies and applicable laws, including interviewing, hiring and training employees; planning, assigning and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; and addressing complaints and resolving problems. 

 Willingly undertake and perform other duties and tasks as assigned. 

 Will have supervisors and lead personnel as well as the hourly production workforce as direct reports. 

Requirements

 A minimum of 5 years of production/operations management experience in manufacturing and operations. 

 Bachelor's degree and lean certification//training preferred. 

 Well-rounded operations management experience including a deep understanding and experience with operations tactics, lean manufacturing, and continuous improvement, strategies and best practices and process discipline. 

 Knowledge of production processes, raw materials, quality control, costs, and other techniques for maximizing the effective manufacture and distribution of goods. 

 Track record of excellent judgment and decision-making ability. 

 Ability to successfully work to reach company goals in an environment in which a wide degree of creativity and latitude is required. 

 Ability to effectively set and communicate expectations & directives to manufacturing staff. 

 Results driven, analytical, self-motivated and detail oriented with the ability to logically identify alternative solutions or approaches to complex problems. 

 Must have demonstrated accountability at the plant management level and have a strong track record of successful execution. 

 Demonstrated success as an innovative manufacturing leader. 

 Demonstrated ability to efficiently and effectively manage operations with excellent communication (verbal and written) and presentation skills. 

Company Benefits

 What You'll Get From Us  Benefits 

With safety as our top priority and a commitment to employee well-being an important focus, we offer comprehensive and competitive benefits that include medical, dental and vision insurance as well as a variety of other well-being resources focused on mental, physical and financial health. Specific benefits and well-being programs may vary depending on where you work.

 Community Engagement 

At Novolex, giving back to the local communities that support us is important. Our Focused Giving Program prioritizes support for organizations whose missions promote sustainability initiatives or address food and hunger needs. We also encourage facility level support of activities in the communities where our employees live and work.

 Training and Development 

We offer constant opportunities for advancement. From skills development to advanced education programs, training and development programs and courses are available through MyLearning. Programs include company and industry training curricula, support for formal education through the Tuition Reimbursement Program (Non-Union), and a Learning Management System that supports and enhances employee skills at all levels of the organization.

Novolex is committed to providing equal employment opportunity in all employment practices, including but not limited to selection, hiring, promotion, transfer, and compensation to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to age, race, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, handicap or disability, genetics, citizenship status, service member or veteran status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law. Any individual who, because of his or her disability, needs an accommodation in connection with an aspect of the Company's application process should contact myHRservices@novolex.com .

title: Head of Human Resources
description:
Join Our Award-Winning Team at Dr. B. Lal Clinical Laboratory Pvt. Ltd !

We are delighted to share that Dr. B. Lal Clinical Laboratory Pvt. Ltd. has been recognized among India’s Top 100 Great Mid-Size Workplaces 2025 — a proud moment in our journey of excellence. Watch the proud moment here: Award Ceremony

As we continue to scale new heights in diagnostic healthcare, we invite passionate professionals to join our team.

Role Clarity | Head of Human Resources

Location: Corporate Office, Jaipur

Role Definition

The Head Human Resources is responsible for driving business performance through people by ensuring effective talent acquisition, performance management, capability building, governance, and culture execution across the organization.

This role integrates all HR verticals to ensure that people, performance, and culture are aligned with business growth and operational excellence.

Key Deliverables

Talent Readiness & Quality Hiring

Performance Management & People Score Improvement

HR Operations Excellence & Compliance Governance

Capability Building & Learning Impact

Employee Engagement & Culture

Succession Planning & Leadership Pipeline

HR Analytics, MIS & Strategic Decision Support

HR Cost Control & Workforce Efficiency

Key Responsibilities

Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning

Define annual and quarterly manpower plan aligned with business growth (zone, function, channel-wise)

Review sanctioned vs actual manpower and identify hiring gaps proactively

Drive prioritization of critical roles (Pathologists, Sales, Lab Ops, Quality roles)

Ensure role clarity, JD standardization, and competency alignment before hiring. Conduct weekly hiring review with TA team and HRBPs (pipeline, closures, delays)

Monitor sourcing mix (job portals, referrals, institutes, mapping) and optimize channels.

Ensure strong candidate experience and employer branding at all touchpoints

Track and improve key metrics: Time to fill; Quality of hire; Cost per hire, etc.

Build future talent pipeline through Campus programs (Udaan) and Internships and institute tie-ups.

Review early exit (0–180 days) cases and drive corrective hiring actions

Performance Management & People Score

Design and govern performance management framework (goal setting, mid-review, final review)

Ensure clarity of KPIs/KRAs across all roles and alignment with business targets.

Drive quarterly People Score review (attrition, vacancy, engagement, learning)

Ensure differentiation - Identify high performers and create growth plans and Identify bottom performers and initiate PIP/exit actions

Monitor completion and quality of performance reviews across organization

Ensure linkage of performance with Rewards & recognition; Variable pay and Career progression

Track performance improvement trends and take corrective actions.

HR Business Partnering & Manager Effectiveness

Define a clear HRBP charter aligned with business units and zones.

Conduct weekly/monthly reviews with HRBPs on Hiring; Attrition; Engagement and Performance issues

Enable managers to conduct effective team reviews; give structured feedback and Handle performance issues

Strengthen grievance handling mechanism - Timely resolution; Documentation and Escalation management

Conduct skip-level interactions to capture ground-level insights.

Drive accountability of managers on Team performance; Retention and Culture adherence

Identify and coach low-performing managers

HR Operations & Compliance Governance

Ensure complete adherence to statutory compliance (PF, ESIC, Bonus, Gratuity, etc.)

Oversee payroll processing - Validate inputs and ensure zero error salary disbursement

Ensure 100% accuracy and completeness of employee documentation

Monitor HRMS (Keka) data integrity - Employee master; Reporting structure and Cost center mapping

Review audit readiness (internal and external audits)

Conduct quarterly HR audits and ensure closure of NCs

Monitor HR cost vs budget - Identify deviations and take corrective actions

Ensure effective functioning of WeCare Helpdesk: SLA adherence; Query closure quality and Root cause analysis of repeat issues

Drive SOP governance and standardization across all HR processes

Learning & Capability Building (DBCL GURUKUL)

Define annual learning strategy aligned with business and capability gaps

Ensure execution of Aarambh (Onboarding journey); Utkarsh (Functional capability); Udaan (Future talent); Saarthi (Manager development) and LEAD (Succession pipeline)

Approve learning calendar and ensure adherence

Monitor learning dashboards - Participation; Completion; Feedback and Learning Impact Score

Ensure strong SME ecosystem for internal training delivery

Conduct periodic learning audits to validate on-ground application

Link learning outcomes with Performance improvement and Promotion readiness

Review training effectiveness and redesign programs if required

Employee Engagement & Culture

Define annual engagement strategy aligned with culture goals

Ensure execution of monthly engagement calendar

Review Pulse Survey results and drive action planning

Ensure high participation in engagement initiatives

Drive recognition programs - Monthly; Quarterly and Annual

Strengthen communication channels - Newsletters; HR Connect and Leadership communication

Ensure alignment of leadership behavior with ONE CARE values

Define and implement culture consequences - Positive (recognition, growth) and Negative (corrective action, escalation)

Conduct culture audits and track improvement

Succession Planning & Leadership Pipeline

Conduct quarterly talent review with leadership

Identify HiPo employees across functions and zones

Create individual development plans (IDPs) for HiPos

Track leadership pipeline (ready now, ready soon, ready later)

Ensure execution of LEAD program with clear outcomes

Drive internal mobility and cross-functional exposure

Monitor internal vs external hiring ratio for leadership roles

Document and track promotion readiness and success stories

 HR Analytics, MIS & Strategic Insights

Define HR dashboard structure for leadership reviews

Ensure timely publishing of Weekly HR MIS and Monthly HR dashboards

Analyze trends in Attrition; Hiring; Engagement; Learning and Cost

Present insights with clear action plans to leadership

Drive data-based decision making across business

Ensure accuracy and consistency of all HR data

Support strategy reviews with HR insights and projections

Success Metrics: 

Talent & Hiring: Average Time-to-fill ≤ 11 days; Quality of hire ≥ 90%; Early exit ≤ 5%

Performance & People Score: Achievement of People Score targets (zone/function wise); Reduction in bottom performers; Improvement in retention and engagement

Operations & Compliance: Zero payroll error; 100% audit and compliance readiness; HR cost within approved budget

Learning & Capability: ≥90% learning completion; ≥85% program impact score; Internal promotions and leadership readiness

Engagement & Culture: Pulse Score ≥ 9.0; Participation ≥ 85%; Engagement calendar execution ≥ 95%

Role Requirements:

MBA/PGDM in HR; 12–15 years’ experience with 4–6 years in HR leadership roles

Strong exposure to Talent Acquisition, HRBP, Performance Management, L&D, and Compliance

Experience in multi-location/service industry (Healthcare/Diagnostics preferred)

Strong skills in workforce planning, HR analytics, and business-linked HR execution

High ownership, stakeholder management, and ability to drive performance & culture outcomes

Pay Scale: We offer a competitive salary package commensurate with experience, along with comprehensive benefits and opportunities for professional growth and developme

Join our team and experience a workplace where you'll be supported, encouraged, and empowered to be your best self, both professionally and personally, as part of our ONE CARE culture.

With a commitment to incorporating the finest infrastructural and technological advancements in the global health sector, we have become a distinguished preference over the past 35+ years. Our relentless passion for delivering top-quality services, coupled with the unwavering trust of doctors and patients, has positioned us as a leader in reputed pathology lab networks.

We take immense pride in being recognized as one of the "Top 25 Best Workplaces in Pharmaceuticals, Healthcare, and Biotech India 2025" and achieving Great Place to Work certification for three consecutive years. This recognition reflects our commitment to fostering a positive work culture, employee well-being, and organizational excellence.

Dr. B Lal Clinical Laboratory Pvt. Ltd. stands out as the only Pathology Lab Network with a remarkable presence of 160+ collection centers across Rajasthan. Our highly sophisticated Central Processing Laboratory, equipped with state-of-the-art technology, is complemented by 13+ regional laboratories strategically located in Kotputli, Bhilwara, Ajmer, Alwar, Sriganganagar, Jodhpur, Ahmedabad, Kota, Bharatpur, and Sikar. This expansive network enables us to provide prompt and efficient diagnostic services to our valued customers.

Currently, we offer an extensive range of over 1500+ tests across various disciplines, including:

✔ Clinical Pathology & Biochemistry

✔ Haematology

✔ Microbiology & Serology

✔ Histopathology

✔ Radiology

✔ Molecular Biology

For over 35+ years, these values have guided us to always put our patients first, earning us immense trust and satisfaction from our customers.

As we move forward, Dr. B. Lal Clinical Laboratory remains committed to pushing the boundaries of innovation, enhancing our services, and setting new benchmarks in pathology and healthcare. With advanced technology, a dedicated team, and a patient-centric approach, we continue to build a healthier and better future for all.

As a logistics and supply chain management organization, we are expanding our workforce to meet the increasing demands of our clients across India. The HR Manager will play a pivotal role in supporting this growth by driving strategic recruitment, fostering employee development, and strengthening people management processes. This position offers an exciting opportunity to lead a dynamic HR function in a high-growth environment, helping shape our company's future through talent and culture.

Role: HR Business Partner

Recruitment & Onboarding: Lead the end-to-end hiring process (requisition, sourcing, interviewing, selection, and offer) for mid to senior level roles and oversee new-employee orientation and onboarding programs. Collaborate with department heads to forecast staffing needs and maintain up-to-date job descriptions.

Performance & Policy: Support performance management by administering appraisal processes and coaching managers on feedback. Develop, implement, and communicate HR policies (employee handbook, code of conduct, leave policy) in line with legal requirements and company strategy.

Training & Development: Identify training needs and design/implement employee development programs. Establish training calendars, coordinate induction sessions, and deliver workshops to build workforce skills and capabilities.

Team Leadership: Manage and mentor the HR & Training team (HR coordinators, recruiters, trainers), setting goals and providing coaching to ensure high performance and alignment with business objectives. Delegate tasks effectively and foster a supportive work environment.

HR Administration & Systems: Maintain HR information systems and employee records for recruitment. Ensure timely coordination with Payroll and Finance for statutory contributions. Oversee compliance with all labor laws and internal policies, implementing changes as needed.

Employee Relations & Engagement: Serve as a trusted advisor to employees and managers on HR issues. Address employee concerns, mediate conflicts, and investigate grievances, ensuring fair resolution. title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Job Description

Role- Destination Sites

Location - Jaipur

Atithi Foundation is a not-for-profit organisation working to transform India's tourism sector into a key engine of economic growth. We partner with government bodies, industry leaders, knowledge institutions and community stakeholders to design evidence-based policies and strategies to create livelihoods, safeguard heritage, and strengthen India's position on the global tourism stage.

Our vision: To make India a $490 billion tourism economy by 2035, with inclusive growth, preserving heritage, and showcasing the nation's culture and natural beauty to the world.

Tourism as an Economic Engine: Tourism plays a vital role in India's economy, generating over $200 billion in 2023, accounting for 5.5% of GDP. More importantly, it is a major job creator, supporting nearly 40 million jobs (8% of national employment). Additionally, 54% of the tourism workforce comprises women, highlighting the sector's role in fostering economic inclusion.

India's Untapped Global Potential: Despite its diverse geography and rich cultural heritage, India attracts only 10Mn Foreign visitors. In contrast, China saw 66 million foreign tourists in 2019, while Vietnam and Thailand welcomed 18 million and 40 million, respectively. This gap presents a significant opportunity for India's tourism sector to grow with the right strategies.

Key Challenges to Overcome

Lack of Standardised Data: Tourism is mainly measured by footfall rather than economic impact, limiting effective decision-making

Narrow Brand Image: India is often perceived as an exotic yet challenging destination. A broader appeal is needed to attract more diverse tourists

Concentration of Tourism: Major revenues come from only six destinations, leading to overcrowding and overuse of resources in popular spots like Goa and Shimla

Ease of Doing Business: Complex regulations and lengthy approval processes hinder the development of tourism infrastructure

Cross-Cutting Governance: Developing new tourist destinations requires coordinated efforts across various government departments, which is currently lacking

ATITHI Foundation leverages philanthropy as a catalyst to unlock India's tourism potential, driving economic growth and job creation.

Role Overview

The Project Leader – Destination Sites will anchor Atithi Foundations' work in Jaipur, working closely with state and destination-level stakeholders to unlock tourism potential in key sites such as Khajuraho.

This role is for professionals who enjoy working close to the ground, engaging with government counterparts, local stakeholders, and the private sector to drive tourism transformation at specific destinations.

The role requires comfort with ambiguity, strong on-ground problem-solving skills, and the ability to tailor tourism transformation agendas to the unique context of each destination.

Key Responsibilities

Lead destination-level engagements with state government departments, city administrations, local authorities, and private stakeholders to design and drive tourism transformation initiatives in Jaipur.

Identify and bridge capability gaps (not capacity gaps) within public sector counterparts, helping them think differently about tourism outcomes.

Develop destination-level strategies and roadmaps that link public sector reforms with private sector participation and investment.

Package destination opportunities in a manner that is attractive and credible for private sector players, including hospitality, travel, and experience providers.

Navigate multi-agency environments at the destination level and identify practical levers to drive progress despite institutional complexity.

Work closely with central teams to align destination-level work with broader national tourism frameworks and priorities.

Provide leadership and guidance to project teams comprising Atithi staff, consultants, and organisations.

Track progress rigorously, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure momentum on agreed initiatives.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Experience working on public sector or social sector programmes at the state, district, or city level (or a strong inclination to do so).

Strong on-ground execution skills combined with the ability to think strategically about destination development.

Comfort working in ambiguous environments with evolving objectives and constraints.

Ability to engage constructively with government officials, private sector stakeholders, and local institutions.

Creative, outside-in thinking on how tourism destinations can be repositioned and unlocked.

Strong communication and coordination skills.

Willingness to be based in Jaipur and spend extended time at destination sites when required.

We aim to incubate an organisation dedicated to accelerating India's position as a premier global tourist destination. Atithi Foundation is committed to conducting deep, action-oriented research, driving awareness at both national and international levels, and developing scalable pilot projects to unlock value in tourism.

Join us in this exciting journey to build India's tourism sector and unlock opportunities for millions of Indians!

A Financial Crime Compliance, Analyst works with our clients (banks and non-bank financial institutions) to provide advice and counsel in order to help them fight financial crime and mitigate financial crime risks. The purpose of this role is to detect and investigate unusual financial activity by performing detailed monitoring of account activity and ensuring compliance with regulatory policies, operational policies, and/or reviewing client files for the purpose of performing Know your Customer (KYC) Procedures In short, you are on the front-line of making decisions as to how to keep our clients compliant with applicable law and regulations.

As a Financial Crime Compliance, Analyst, you research and analyze various sources of data and provide written summaries of recommendations and conclusions as it relates to the identification of suspicious or unusual financial activity and/or reviewing client files for the purpose of performing Know your Customer (KYC) Procedures.

You will need to exercise discretion and judgment in the work and must be able to work efficiently and independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Primary Responsibilities

 Evaluate and monitor transactional activity to assess potential suspicious activity.

 Verify the identity of clients to understand the nature and purpose of their relationship with the financial institution for the purposes of performing Know your Customer (KYC) Procedures.

 Interpret and implement client-operating policies regarding financial data.

 Identify data anomalies and red flags for money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, sanctions violations, and escalate for second level review.

 Submit written work product for review by AMLRS and client-led quality control teams, make the requested adjustments as necessary, and apply the feedback going forward.

 Adhere to all designated timeframes and procedure to ensure on time and accurate completion of work.

Required Qualifications

 Strong oral communication skills and ability to produce narrative and written summaries clearly synthesizing recommendations and conclusions.

 Strong analytical, problem solving and organizational skills.

 Ability to multi-task, work independently and as part of a team, establishing cooperative and collaborative working relationships.

Customer Centricity

To power the next phase of Flexmoney’s growth, we are bringing to market a best-in-class Omni-channel Embedded Finance and Affordability Suite - InstaCred 3601. Our new platform will enable merchants, brands and partners to seamlessly embed digital financing options across all sales channels: online, telesales, in-store and field-sales, enabling sales associates to drive higher conversion by surfacing actionable digital affordability options to the consumer much higher up the sales funnel. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
