title: Application Manager - SAP TAM Basis
description:
At Nouryon, our global team takes positive action every day, to reach higher goals collectively and individually. We create innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers to answer society’s needs – today and in the future.

Purpose of the Job

As an Application Manager you are responsible for managing, maintaining and optimizing technological applications within the organization. You will work closely with various stakeholders, including IT teams, user groups and suppliers, to ensure applications meet operational requirements and user needs. You are an essential link between technology and business processes, providing innovative solutions and ensuring smooth operation of applications to improve operational efficiency.

About the job (Job Responsibilities)

As a Technical Application Manager (TAM), your role involves the management and maintenance of SAP systems.

Your responsibilities may include system installation, configuration, monitoring, and performance tuning to ensure the reliability and efficiency of the SAP landscape. You may also need to handle system security, user management, backups, and disaster recovery. Here's a breakdown of the key areas of focus in a typical Technical

Application Manager (TAM)role:

System Installation and Configuration:

· Installing, configuring, and upgrading SAP systems and related components such as SAP HANA,

NetWeaver, and Solution Manager.

· Applying support packages and patches to keep the systems up to date.

System Monitoring and Performance Tuning:

· Monitoring system performance, availability, and capacity to identify and address potential issues.

· Performance tuning, including optimizing parameters and configurations for better system performance.

System Security and User Management:

· Implementing and maintaining system security measures, such as user authentication, authorization, and

single sign-on.

· Managing user accounts, roles, and authorizations to ensure proper access control.

Backup and Recovery:

· Planning and implementing backup strategies to protect SAP data and configurations.

· Developing and testing disaster recovery plans to minimize system downtime in case of failures.

Transport Management:

· Managing and monitoring transports of SAP objects between systems, ensuring consistency and

integrity.

SAP Landscape Maintenance:

· Managing system landscapes, including development, quality assurance, and production systems.

· Ensuring system availability and reliability through proactive maintenance and periodic health checks.

Integration and Interface Monitoring:

· Monitoring and maintaining system interfaces and integrations with other SAP and non-SAP systems.

SAP System Upgrades and Migrations:

· Planning and executing system upgrades and migrations to newer versions or platforms. Documentation and Reporting: 

· Maintaining system documentation, procedures, and operational guides.

· Providing regular reports on system performance, status, and ongoing activities.

Troubleshooting and Issue Resolution:

· Investigating and resolving system issues, errors, and performance problems.

· Conduct conference call meetings/ Incident war-room to resolve critical incidents.

· Collaborating with SAP functional teams and technical support to address complex issues.

· Enhance business perception of IT by quickly resolving and communicating requests and incidents · Responsible for ongoing analysis, documentation, management and reporting of incidents and requests in daily operations.

· Drive knowledge management and value extraction within the TAM domain.

 Compliance and Best Practices:

· Ensure compliance (GDPR, SOX and industry standards) with regulations and security standards related to the applications, including data protection, privacy and information security.

· Implementing best practices for SAP system administration and operation.

Application Management: 

· Manage and maintain various technology applications, including installation, configuration, monitoring, upgrades and troubleshooting.

· Cooperate with delivery managers AMS and Hosting and service improvement managers in creating an end-to-end service experience for the customer.

· Acts as problem manager to structurally resolve recurring incidents and problems.

· Responsible for execution of the service level agreements from suppliers and towards the customers and ensuring that these are met.

· Understand his/her part within an End-to-End Service mindset not just the TAM components and impact from a business/user’s perspective.

· Makes sure that all IT Service Management processes, Operational Level Agreements and Underpinning Contracts are appropriate and aligned for the agreed service level targets.

· Contribute to the operational integrity globally through continuous improvement.

· Oversees the delivery of Technical Application Management services by key suppliers.

· Recognizes potential strategic application of IT solutions/assets to the benefit of the organization. · Responsible for managing and controlling the full IT landscape and makes sure IM services are delivered in line with architecture guidelines and principles.

· Keep CMDB up to date for the technical processes and applications in scope.

· Supporting project handover activities (hand over from deliverables and knowledge from a project to the Technical Maintenance teams) for the area of responsibility.

· Support projects in execution of changes / enhancements · Retaining landscape specific knowledge, acting as a template gatekeeper.

· Enforces the global process, establish close links with project teams, challenge and find ways of improving the controls of landscape management.

· Ensures the landscape is kept well performing and healthy through functional checks, continuous improvements and technical projects in relevant area(s).

· Ensure that work instructions are provided that work schedules are established and that adequate resources are assigned to ensure effective end-to-end service delivery, this to be able to meet customer specifications and service levels.

· Forecast planning per agreed period including suppliers.

· Collaboration with peers in the full-service chain.

· Pro-actively contribute to the operational integrity of IM operations globally through continuous improvement and operational excellence.

· Raise the bar by continuously look for ways to improve, also by staying abreast of external trends · Align with PMO and Manager AMS on projects with possible impact on area of responsibility.

· Drive the Service Introduction for the area of responsibility ensuring a seamless introduction into the landscape and support function Stakeholder management.

· Collaborate with internal users, IT teams and external vendors to understand user needs, translate technical requirements into application solutions and manage expectations.

Technical Support:

· Provide technical support and guidance to users in using applications, troubleshoot problems, and provide training as needed.

· Responsible to maintain Capacity & Performance proactively by driving various measures together with Service Provider for both SAP & Non-SAP applications.

Application Optimization:

· Identify process improvement and application optimization opportunities, implement improvements, and conduct regular assessments to monitor performance.

We believe you bring (Education & Experience)

Master/ bachelor's degree in business management, computer science, computer engineering.

Professional with minimum of 6 years of experience in the IT sector including 5 years minimum managing IT TAM services (mainly SAP Basis area) & professionals across a diverse geographical and cultural spread.

Strong project management / portfolio managements experience.

Knowledge of the manufacturing/ process industry.

Knowledge of best practice solutions in the shared solutions space.

Experience in relevant TAM services, with deep knowledge/experience of SAP system administration, SAP Basis management and know databases (DB2, HANA, MaxDB, SQLServer, etc) and servers (AIX, Linux, Windows, etc).

Wintel knowledge is a plus. · Individual must demonstrate ability to act autonomously · Excellent communication and collaboration skills, both oral and written.

Problem solving skills and the ability to work effectively under pressure.

Positive, proactive, enthusiastic attitude, self-motivated.

Is dedicated to reaching and maintaining the required quality of system performance and solution.

SAP RISE and SAP solution Manager experience would be preferable.

SAP BTP admin & SAP Analytical Cloud knowledge would be a plus.

Please apply via our online recruitment system. We will not accept applications via e-mail. Once it's with us we will review to see if we have a match between your skills and the role! For more information about our hiring process, visit: nouryon.com/careers/how-we-hire/

We look forward to receiving your application!

We kindly ask our internal candidates to apply with your Nouryon email via Success Factors.

If you’re looking for your next career move, apply today and join Nouryon’s worldwide team of Changemakers in providing essential solutions that our customers use to manufacture everyday products such as personal care, cleaning, paints and coatings, agriculture and food, pharmaceuticals, and building products. Our employees are driven by the wish to make an impact and actively drive positive change. If that describes you, we will gladly make way for your ambitions. From day one we support you with your personal growth, through challenging positions and comprehensive learning and development opportunities, in a dynamic, international, diverse, and proactive working environment.

What makes us different?

On the surface, we’re one of the nation’s largest audit, tax, consulting, and wealth management firms. But dig a little deeper, and you’ll see what makes us different: we’re a relatively jerk-free firm (hey, nobody ‘s perfect) with a world-class culture, consistent recognition as one of Fortune Magazine’s “100 Best Companies to Work For,” and an endless array of opportunities.  At Plante Moran, diversity, equity and inclusion means that all staff members have equitable and fair opportunities to succeed, in an inclusive environment, with their individual, unique identities. So, what are you waiting for? Apply now.

description:
Dezerv is a house of investing solutions for high-net-worth and affluent Indians. Dezerv is co-founded by Sandeep Jethwani, Vaibhav Porwal, and Sahil Contractor. They have led successful wealth management businesses and managed over USD 7 billion in assets. The Dezerv team brings together decades of investing expertise from leading global financial institutions like JP Morgan, UBS, BNP Paribas, etc. Our team of experts monitors the performance of portfolios and rebalance them if required to ensure long-term success. We are backed by marquee firms like Premji Invest, Accel, Elevation, Matrix, etc. Since inception, our clients have trusted us with over 16000+ Crs of their assets.

Why are we building Dezerv?

Investing is stressful and emotional. Building & growing wealth is difficult and time-consuming. Most individuals struggle with managing their investments and money. Our goal is to help individuals grow their wealth without the stress, time, and costs involved in a traditional investment. At Dezerv, we are building a platform that leverages our decades of investment expertise to help individuals invest better for their future.

What are we trying to solve/mission?

We are passionate about helping Indians invest better. We manage investments with active oversight to help both sophisticated and new investors build long-term wealth across various market conditions.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized PMS Operations Executive to join our company. As a PMS Operations Executive, you will play a crucial role in managing the operational aspects of our portfolio management services. You will work closely with various teams to ensure the seamless execution of investment operations, client onboarding, trade settlement, and compliance with regulatory requirements.

Responsibilities:

Trade Settlement: Work closely with brokers, custodians, and fund administrators to ensure timely and accurate settlement of trades. Monitor trade confirmations, resolve any discrepancies, and follow up on failed trades. Maintain proper records of trade settlements and reconciliation.

Rebalancing and Cash Management: Collaborate with the portfolio management team to implement portfolio rebalancing strategies and manage cash flows. Ensure accurate cash projections, timely fund transfers, and efficient allocation of funds across client portfolios.

Performance Reporting: Generate and distribute performance reports to clients, providing accurate and detailed information on portfolio performance, asset allocation, and transaction history. Coordinate with the portfolio management team to gather necessary data and ensure report accuracy.

Compliance and Risk Management: Ensure compliance with regulatory guidelines and internal policies related to portfolio management operations. Assist in conducting periodic compliance reviews, identifying any gaps, and implementing corrective measures. Monitor operational risk factors and contribute to risk management efforts.

Data Management: Maintain accurate and up-to-date client and portfolio data in the system. Perform regular data validation and reconciliation to ensure data integrity. Collaborate with the technology team to enhance data management processes and systems.

Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline and automate operational processes to improve efficiency and reduce errors. Propose and implement process enhancements, leveraging technology and best practices.

Relationship Management: Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders, including portfolio managers, sales, and compliance teams, to ensure smooth operations and client satisfaction. Provide timely and accurate responses to inquiries from internal and external stakeholders.

Requirements:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field. Additional certifications or qualifications in operations or finance would be a plus.

Experience: Minimum of 2+ years of experience in portfolio management operations, wealth management, or a similar role within the financial services industry.

Knowledge: Familiarity with investment products, portfolio management processes, trade settlement, BSE Star and regulatory requirements in the wealth management industry. Proficiency in using Wealth management and MS Excel.

Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data management and reporting. Ability to spot discrepancies and resolve issues proactively.

Communication Skills: Ability to effectively communicate with internal teams, clients, brokers, and custodians.

Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and provide insights to support decision-making.

Organizational Skills: Exceptional organizational and time management skills. Ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and multitask in a fast-paced environment.

Team Player: Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and contribute to a positive and collaborative work environment.

title: IT Support Analyst
description:
About Colt Data Centre Services

Colt Data Centre Services has over 20 years of experience in designing, building and operating energy-efficient, reliable data centres - hosting significant financial, media, corporate and cloud wholesale providers across the world.

Our customers are at the heart of everything we do, we endeavour to take a customer led approach across our operations striving to serve our customers with a seamless experience no matter what facility or region they are in.

Finding the right solutions for our customers starts with finding the right people for Colt DCS. We believe in creating a healthy, learning environment for our employees to flourish.

MISSION

The IT Support Engineer plays a key role in ensuring the stability, security, and effective operation of Colt DCS end-user technology.

Reporting to the Service Support Manager, this role provides first and second-line support for workplace technologies such as laptops, printers, monitors, peripherals, and meeting room solutions, alongside a suite of core business systems and Microsoft 365 applications.

This is a hybrid role with an expectation to work onsite three days per week, providing hands-on support for workplace technology and acting as a visible IT presence for end users. The role coordinates with third-party service providers for hardware support while managing incidents and service requests through to resolution. Travel to nearby Colt DCS sites may also be required to provide onsite support where needed.

The IT Support Engineer performs structured investigations, implements break-fix solutions, and works closely with internal technology teams and external suppliers to restore services efficiently and maintain a high-quality support experience for users.

OUTCOMES

Workplace Technology Support: Provide first and second-line support for end-user technology, including laptops, peripherals, printers, and meeting room systems, ensuring incidents and service requests are managed effectively and resolved within agreed service levels.

Onsite IT Presence & End-User Support: Act as a visible IT presence by providing onsite support (three days per week) for workplace technology, diagnosing and resolving user issues, and coordinating with third-party providers where hardware replacement or specialist support is required.

Incident & Request Management: Take ownership of tickets throughout their lifecycle, performing structured investigations, implementing break-fix solutions, and ensuring clear communication with users until resolution.

Vendor & Supplier Coordination: Work closely with internal technology teams and external suppliers to ensure effective escalation and resolution of incidents affecting end-user technology.

Device & Technology Deployment: Support the rollout, configuration, and upgrade of end-user devices and workplace technology solutions, helping ensure smooth adoption of new tools and services across Colt DCS.

Knowledge & Documentation Management: Maintain and update knowledge articles, user guides, and internal documentation to support users and improve the efficiency of the support function.

Global Team Collaboration: Collaborate with colleagues across regions to support consistent global service coverage and ensure users receive reliable IT support.

THE TEAM

The Colt DCS Technology function is structured as follows:-

Technology Business Partner

Business Applications Team comprising Architecture, Delivery, Operations and Support.

Infrastructure Team comprising Architecture, Delivery Operations and Support.

IT Service Management Team.

Project Management.

This role sits within the IT Service Management Team, reporting to the IT Service Support Manager. The team is responsible for providing support for business applications and workplace technology across Colt DCS, ensuring users receive reliable, responsive, and high-quality IT services.

The team consists of several IT support professionals working collaboratively to deliver global support coverage and maintain a strong service-focused culture.

The IT Support Engineer works closely with colleagues across the Technology function, including the Business Applications and Infrastructure teams, as well as with third-party suppliers providing workplace technology and hardware support.

THE SKILLS / EXPERTISE THEY BRING

IT Support & Troubleshooting – Some experience in IT support or a technical service desk environment, providing first-line support across end-user technology and business applications.

Workplace Technology Support – Familiarity with supporting workplace technologies such as Microsoft 365, laptops, monitors, peripherals, and meeting room systems, helping users work productively in both office and remote environments.

Service Management Awareness – Understanding of IT service management concepts such as incident management, request fulfilment, and ticket lifecycle management. Familiarity with ITIL principles is desirable.

IT Service Management Tools – Experience using IT service management platforms such as Cherwell, Neurons, Jira, ServiceNow, or similar ticketing systems is beneficial.

Problem-Solving Skills – Ability to troubleshoot common technical issues, follow structured investigation steps, and escalate issues when required.

Technical Learning Agility – Quick to learn new systems, tools, and business processes, with the ability to adapt to a diverse technology environment.

Communication – Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical users.

Vendor & Supplier Collaboration – Comfortable working with third-party suppliers and service providers, including coordinating escalations and collaborating on the resolution of technical issues.

Documentation & Knowledge Sharing – Ability to contribute to knowledge articles, user guides, and internal documentation to support users and improve support processes.

Professionalism & Customer Focus – Demonstrates a positive, customer-focused approach with attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality user support.

WHAT WE OFFER

We offer skill development, learning pathways and accreditation to help our people perform at their best, regardless of role and location.

In addition to offering competitive salaries and incentive plans, a range of benefits and local rewards packages are offered to staff. Colt DCS recognises the importance of a work life balance.

title: IOS Developer (AI Native)
description:
Our Mission

Fuel customer growth through meaningful, intelligent, and safe user-to-user (and now, user-to-agent) engagement.

CometChat Overview

CometChat is a full-stack conversational platform built to unify every layer of interaction - bringing together real-time conversations (chat, messaging, voice, and video), AI Agents, moderation, notifications, and analytics in one modular, developer-first solution.

Our company has seen rapid growth, thanks to several market validations - including our participation in the Techstars Boulder Accelerator in 2019, followed by investments from experienced investors such as iSeed Ventures, Range Ventures, Silicon Badia, and Matchstick Ventures. CometChat raised a Series A round from Signal Peak Ventures, and most recently closed a $6.5M strategic round from Run Ventures - bringing our total funding to $21.1M. In the last 12 months alone, we've surpassed 2 billion messages sent through our platform.

We were also recognized on Forbes' 2026 America's Top 500 Startup Employers List - a reflection of the team and culture we've been deliberate about building.

We believe the interface of the future is conversation - not clicks. Every app will soon have an AI layer that's as native as text messaging today. That's why we're building the infrastructure for the world's AI-powered conversations - from human-to-human, to human-to-agent, to multi-party collaboration with AI in the mix.

From AI onboarding assistants that get users productive in minutes, to copilots that perform complex workflows in-app, to intelligent moderators that protect and guide communities in real time - our AI Agent platform makes it all possible.

With CometChat's ready-to-use UI kits, powerful SDKs, and our Full Stack AI Agent Platform, product teams across startups and enterprises can launch safe, scalable, and smart in-app interactions faster than ever.

Why Join Us Now

We're at the tipping point where AI becomes a native part of every conversation. At CometChat, you'll help shape a future where users can talk to their apps as naturally as to a friend - where agents think, reason, act, and collaborate with humans in real time.

You won't just be joining a product team - you'll be building the standard for AI interaction layers: agent-aware UI, intelligent guardrails, rich actions libraries, and multi-party collaboration between people and AI.

If you want to help define how the next billion users will communicate - and push the boundaries of what's possible in real-time, AI-powered engagement - we'd love to work with you.

What We Mean By AI-native

AI-native here means you build with agents by default. We expect 100% of the code to be generated via agentic tools (Cursor, Claude Code, and similar), while you own everything that actually matters: problem framing, architecture, tradeoffs, review quality, tests, performance, and security. This is not "vibe coding." The code is generated. The thinking is yours. You should be great at steering agents, validating output, catching subtle issues early, and debugging code you did not manually write.

Why AI-native

Software development is changing permanently, and we are leaning all the way in. You will work in a team that ships fast with agents, where your leverage comes from judgment and systems thinking rather than typing speed. You will get access to whatever AI tools you need (Cursor, Claude Code, or anything else that makes you effective), and the freedom to use them aggressively. If you want to operate at the edge of how modern engineering gets done and level up your output, this role is built for that.

Join us to build where AI meets human connection.

Position Overview & Priorities

We are looking for versatile and experienced technical additions to our development team. The position offers an extensive amount of ownership and influence over our development process as we scale the team. We’re looking for people who enjoy solving meaningful problems and love seeing the things they build in the hands of real users.

Primary responsibility would be:

Designing and building applications/SDK for the iOS platform

Ensuring the performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications

Collaborating with a team to define, design, and ship new features

Defining correct architecture and following the right design principles.

Helping maintain code quality, organization, and automatization

Work Location

Chembur, Mumbai

Prioritized Experiences And Capabilities

Minimum 1-3 years of experience in iOS app development

Leverage AI-native development workflows, including agentic IDEs and coding assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code), to accelerate delivery while maintaining code quality, security, and engineering standards.

Proficiency with Objective-C and Swift.

Experience in iOS frameworks such as Core Data, Core Animation, etc.

Experience with offline storage, threading, and performance tuning

Familiarity with RESTful APIs to connect iOS applications to back-end services

Knowledge of other web technologies and UI/UX standards

Understanding of Apple’s design principles and interface guidelines

Knowledge of low-level C-based libraries is preferred

Familiarity with cloud message APIs and push notifications

Knack for benchmarking and optimization

Proficient understanding of code versioning tools

Familiarity with continuous integration

Here are the values that act as a guardrail of our execution culture: 

Go above and beyond for the customer: We are obsessed with ensuring every customer is taken care of, no matter how big or small they are. We truly believe their problems are our problems, and will stop at next to nothing to see them succeed.

Be relentless: Never stop innovating. Be relentless in trying new things, and improving our product. Challenge the status quo, embrace learning curves, and don’t be afraid to fail. Focus on the outcome and everything else will fall into place.

Be curious: Practice empathy. Anticipate customer needs, and solve them before they get there. If you don’t understand something, ask questions and learn.

Have fun: Laugh. Be positive and kind. Make people feel good. Life is too short to not spend time doing what you love with folks you enjoy being around.

Interview Process

Our goal is to make sure you have the chance to get to know CometChat as we learn more about you. Through a series of conversations with CometChat’s founders and key stakeholders, we’ll want to learn more about your strategic and functional expertise, and your passion. We hope that you’ll bring questions and ideas to each conversation and suggest ways that we can get to know you and your capabilities better.

title: Financial Planning & Analysis Analyst
description:
BASIC FUNCTION

The FP&A Analyst is a trusted business partner who adds value by providing accurate, timely, and pertinent financial guidance and is responsible for driving a deep understanding of financial performance. He/she is responsible for monthly variance reporting, forecasting, budgeting and strategic planning. Highly curious individual with the analytical rigor and strategic thinking to move the company’s processes to a new level. Dynamic role that interfaces with many levels of the organization and works in close partnership with highly talented business and finance partners. Flexible and highly motivated with strong communication skills and a drive for continuous improvement. This role is responsible for analyzing and reporting on specific company level performance, along with necessary deep dives based on results. High level interaction with Operations leadership. Strong excel and Power BI skills are a must.

REPORTING TO

Director of FP&A

JOB FUNCTION

 Performs monthly, QTD and YTD variance analysis for actual results to prior year, budget and forecast.

 Prepares monthly management financial reporting package including P&L, Balance Sheet and Statement of Cash Flows and related variance analysis.

 Assists with the development, implementation, automation, and maintenance of budgeting, general, and cost accounting systems.

 Assist in the preparation of the Monthly Reporting Pack that is presented to the ELT and Investcorp

 Provide the management team with clear insights driven by strong analytics that support improvement within the plants.

 Drive pricing performance and partner with pricing consultants to implement pricing model

 Develop tools to support data analytics and reporting, such as Business Intelligence and Data Warehouse

 Financial analysis to support operational objectives and projects

 Proactively looking for trends, best practices, and opportunities to drive improvement

 Work extensively with business leaders to understand what is happening in the business and help articulate the action items and messaging to leadership and the broader organization

 Translate operational metrics into financial impact to help business prioritize business issues

 Act as the subject matter expert in regards to the company’s financial consolidation and forecasting tool: Adaptive Planning

SKILLS And ABILITIES

 Demonstrated experience handling complex modeling and analysis

 Proficient in reading, understanding, and analyzing key financial statements

 Exceptional communication skills with ability to present analysis and findings in both verbal and written formats to all levels of management

description:

Proven experience in leading and managing cross-functional teams and influencing stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

Hands-on experience with GRC platforms (e.g., ServiceNow IRM) and data analytics tools for compliance monitoring.

Deep knowledge of industry authoritative sources and frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, COBIT, SOX, and GDPR/data privacy standards.

Strong background in cybersecurity risks, controls definition, and IT infrastructure.

title: Director- Financial Crime Compliance - Gurugram, India
description:

About AML RightSource

We are AML RightSource, the leading technology-enabled managed services firm focused on fighting financial crime for our clients and the world. Headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, and operating across the globe, we are a trusted partner to our financial institution, FinTech, money service business, and corporate clients.

Using a blend of highly trained anti-financial crime professionals, cutting-edge technology tools, and industry-leading consultants, we help clients with their AML/BSA, transaction monitoring, client onboarding (KYC), enhanced due diligence (EDD), and risk management needs.

We support clients in meeting day-to-day compliance tasks, urgent projects, and strategic changes. Globally, our staff of more than 4,000 highly trained analysts and subject matter experts is the industry's largest group of full-time compliance professionals. Together with our clients, we are Reimagining Compliance.

About The Position

As a Director in our Financial Crime Compliance Managed Services group, you will be responsible for exercising leadership and strategic direction over client projects, while supporting the growth of AMLRS' business and people. The successful candidate should possess strong working knowledge and understanding of Anti-Money Laundering (“AML”) regulatory requirements and industry best practices to direct teams to produce high quality deliverables for clients on projects; as well as possess the ability to lead the development of new methodologies and approaches to address client needs.

The Director should understand and have the ability to work in an agile, dynamic environment and be able to exercise governance and oversight on multiple AML/financial crime projects.

This role requires collaboration with cross-jurisdictional teams and requires the ability to exercise sound judgment and AML knowledge to manage risk and ensure that product deliverables are executed with a high level of quality in within project timelines.

Primary Responsibilities

Provide operational soundness and compliance on AML/FC engagements:

Lead financial crime engagements in accordance with terms of service agreements stipulated in the executed statement of work (SOW)/contract. 

Set the tone for quality standards and issue escalation and management on the engagement. 

Serve as a point of contact for issues escalated by the Manager and Senior Managers on the engagement and ensures prompt resolution of potential issues while managing client expectations. 

Define and review KPI/ KRI/ dashboard reports needed to effectively manage risks on the engagement. 

 Define and review all pertinent client deliverables prior to submission to the client. 

Attend key client meetings and ensure that internal and external meetings are attended by the appropriate AMLRS team members. 

Oversee the engagement leverage model to ensure that it is continuously assessed and adequate to meet the needs of the client; as well as consider and escalate any contractual amendments required to maintain sound operation and execution of the engagement. 

Ensure that Senior Managers on the engagement exercise appropriate oversight and management over Time reporting by all members of the engagement team. 

Ensure that client billing is completed timely and correctly and approve invoices in a timely manner. 

Work with Senior Managers on the engagement to ensure that performance reviews are completed appropriately and timely. 

Client Relationship Management:

Leverage knowledge and experience to help identify new client opportunities (through client interaction and governance and oversight of the engagement team) and discuss with Account Management and Sales functions. 

Organize and lead periodic touch points with client stakeholders to assess their needs and obtain feedback around AMLRS performance, including organizing and leading bi-annual/annual executive meetings with the client key stakeholders. 

Manage and coordinate certain internal strategic initiatives across the Managed Services practice working closely with Sr Managers and Managers and providing updates to practice leads and rest of the organization as appropriate. 

Mentor and coach Engagement Teams:

Establish and set the tone for developing strong, inclusive mentoring and coaching relationships on the engagement, across all staff levels. 

Set the tone and encourage personal development on the engagement (i.e. encourage attendance of AMLRS trainings and personal development events and initiatives) 

Partner with Shared Service teams to address human capital and information technology related needs. 

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree 

Overall, 18- 22 years or more of AML / Financial Crimes experience, with an understanding of regulatory requirements as it pertains to areas such as transaction monitoring, AML policies and procedures, KYC, EDD and AML independent testing, and compliance transformation 

Proven ability to lead, mentor and coach teams of up to 200+ analysts. 

Very strong entrepreneurial spirit - highly collaborative, able to express ideas readily, manage change fluidly, able to influence and identify opportunities. 

Strong problem solving and analytical skills 

Effective issue management skills. 

Demonstrated client and team relationship management and development experience

CAMS Certification 

MBA

New Business Acquisition

title: Monotype Solutions - Salesforce Director
description:
Role Overview

As a Senior Manager / Director Salesforce, you will lead a team responsible for designing, configuring, and developing Salesforce solutions across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Support. You will act as the local Salesforce technical authority, guiding solution designs, reviewing code and configurations, mentoring junior team members, and ensuring adherence to best practices.

The ideal candidate will be technically proficient and an exceptional communicator. This individual should be capable of setting the ongoing Salesforce roadmap in collaboration with the go-to-market team, while leading a small team of Salesforce technical talent in India. You may also oversee a couple of business analysts as part of your team to support analysis and solution design.

As a technical expert, the leader will bring strong knowledge of Salesforce development best practices, tools, and processes, provide technical recommendations to the team, and proactively identify and evaluate new technologies to enhance the platform.

You will collaborate closely with business analysts, solution architects, and Salesforce business owners to define requirements, estimate efforts, and deliver scalable, high-quality Salesforce solutions. You will also ensure proper documentation, participate in product demos and retrospectives, and drive improvements across the Salesforce platform.

What Were Looking For

Team Leadership : 

 Develop technical acumen of self and team.

 Train, coach, and supervise developers on Salesforce and Agile practices.

 Lead strategies to solve complex technical challenges.

 Manage large-scale projects including JIRA project planning, resource management, and delivery oversight.

 Define and maintain global Salesforce development standards for code, source control, and deployments.

 Set the Salesforce roadmap in collaboration with go-to-market and cross-functional teams.

 Lead a small Salesforce technical team in India, with potential oversight of business analysts.

Salesforce Technical Expertise

 Strong knowledge of Salesforce standard objects, workflows, API integrations, reporting, and overall CRM architecture.

 Experience with Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, Einstein AI, Agent Workspace, CPQ, Revenue Cloud, and related Salesforce modules.

 Hands-on expertise with Apex, Aura, LWC, Flows, SOQL, Visualforce, batch processes, and asynchronous operations.

 Experience integrating Salesforce with third-party applications, including Mulesoft.

 Knowledge of developer tools, debugging, automated testing, and release management.

 Salesforce Advanced Administrator and/or Developer certifications preferred.

Data Management

 Understand relational database structures and ensure data governance.

 Collaborate with the Global Data team for data integrity and compliance.

Application Administration & Support

 Identify solutions for system/process issues and enhancements.

 Ensure quality in code and team deliverables in a hybrid engineering model.

Qualifications

 12+ years of total experience with 8+ in Salesforce technical leadership (technical lead, architect, or development manager).

 3 to 6 years of experience in Service/Sales process improvement projects.

 Proven ability to lead development teams, enforce best practices, and manage a complex CRM environment.

 Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently while understanding broader business goals.

 Exceptional communication and collaboration skills to set roadmaps and coordinate with cross-functional teams.

 Experience managing small, high-performing Salesforce teams, potentially including business analysts.

 Excellent mentoring, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.

title: Java Developer - API Devlopment
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Java Developer to design, develop, and test RESTful APIs using Spring Boot. The role involves implementing business logic and data access layers, integrating with various data sources, and collaborating with a team of developers and stakeholders to deliver high-quality microservices solutions. The ideal candidate will be passionate about writing clean, well-documented code, troubleshooting application issues, and contributing to process improvements.

Must-Have Skillsets (Mandatory)

 Java & Spring Framework: Proficiency in Java and the Spring Framework (Spring Boot), with experience in developing RESTful APIs and implementing business logic.

 Integration: Experience integrating with various data sources, including SQL and NoSQL databases, message queues, and external APIs.

 Code Quality: Ability to write clean, well-documented, and testable code, and contribute to overall code quality through code reviews.

 Debugging & Troubleshooting: Strong problem-solving skills for troubleshooting and debugging application issues.

 Collaboration: Experience working in a collaborative team environment with developers, testers, and other stakeholders.

 Continuous Improvement: A mindset of continuous improvement, contributing to the enhancement of development processes and tools.

Good-to-Have Skillsets (Optional)

 Microservices: Familiarity with designing and developing microservices-based architectures.

 Technology Advancements: Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in Java, Spring, and related technologies.

 Development Processes: Experience with agile development practices and contributing to team efficiency.

Qualifications & Experience

 Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

 Experience: Proven experience in Java development, particularly in designing and implementing APIs with Spring Boot and integrating with databases and external services.

 Professional Skills: Strong communication skills, analytical thinking, and a passion for delivering high-quality solutions.

title: Machine Learning Scientist I
description:
Why Lytx?:

As our Machine Learning Engineer, you will join our Applied Machine Learning Team in India, who develops machine learning and computer vision algorithms to monitor and assess the state of drivers and their environments to identify risk and improve safety for our clients. You will contribute to all aspects of the DL/ML model development and deployment cycle to improve the accuracy and throughput at reduced latency to help enhance and differentiate us as the leader in the Video Safety and Telematics industry. If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply!

What You'll Do

 Develop ML/DL models end-to-end — problem formulation, data engineering, prototyping, training, evaluation, and iteration.

description:
About Origin

Origin (previously 10xConstruction) is building general-purpose autonomous robots for US construction to tackle rising costs, safety risks, and labor shortages. Our modular, multi-trade platform combines purpose-built hardware with real-time site intelligence to navigate complex environments and execute tasks with precision. Trained in high-fidelity simulation and already deployed on live sites, our robots deliver 5x faster execution, 250%+ margin expansion, and significant cost savings. Join India's most talent-dense robotics team consisting of individuals from IITs, Stanford, UCLA, etc.

About The Role

As an AI Research Intern you'll push the frontiers of generative and multimodal learning that power our autonomous robots. You will prototype diffusion-based vision models, vision-language architectures (VLAs/VLMs) and automated data-annotation pipelines that turn raw site footage into training gold.

Key Responsibilities

Design and train diffusion-based generative models for realistic, high-resolution synthetic data. 

Build compact Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to caption, query and retrieve job-site scenes for downstream perception tasks. 

Develop Vision-Language Action Models (VLA) objectives that link textual work-orders with pixel-level segmentation masks

Architect large-scale auto-annotation pipelines that transform unlabeled images / point-clouds into high-quality labels with minimal human input. 

Benchmark model performance on accuracy, latency and memory for deployment on Jetson-class hardware; compress with distillation or LoRA. 

Collaborate with perception and robotics teams to integrate research prototypes into live ROS 2 stacks. 

Requirements

Qualifications & Skills

Strong foundation in deep learning, probabilistic modeling and computer vision (coursework or research projects)

Hands-on experience with diffusion models (e.g., DDPM, Latent Diffusion) in PyTorch or JAX

Familiarity with multimodal transformers / VLMs (CLIP, BLIP, Flamingo, LLaVA, etc.) and contrastive pre-training objectives. 

Working knowledge of data-centric AI: active learning, self-training, pseudo-labeling and large-scale annotation pipelines

Solid coding skills in Python, PyTorch / Lightning, plus git-driven workflows; bonus for C++ and CUDA kernels

Bonus: experience with on-device inference (TensorRT, ONNX Runtime) & synthetic data tools (Isaac Sim). 

Preferred Experiences

PyTorch or JAX

C++

CUDA kernels

ONNX Runtime

TensorRT

Isaac Sim

Latent Diffusion

We are a fast-growing, India-based AI x EdTech company building the next generation of intelligent learning tools. If you are early in your career, have a sharp eye for detail, and care deeply about education, this is the perfect place to launch your Product Management journey.

Test out user workflows to ensure they remain the most intuitive for students & teachers

Help carry out cross-browser and cross-device testing checklists before each release.

title: AI-Native Intern
description:
Why this exists:

Mumzworld is the Middle East’s largest e-commerce destination for everything: mother, baby, and child. We serve millions of parents from Dubai to Riyadh, and we’re now rebuilding the company to be AI-native end to end.

That means agents handling real customer - Recommendation systems that follow a child’s growth from pregnancy to pre-teen. Copilots for our merchandising, buying, and logistics teams. Tooling that turns our catalog and parenting content into something genuinely intelligent. We want builders who can sit inside this and move the needle fast. Whether you’re writing the code or defining what gets built, you’ll own production work that real mothers use.

Two tracks

Pick the one that matches how you work. If you do both well, tell us in your application.

Track A: AI Engineering Intern

You’ll be shipping production AI systems. Expect to:

Build and deploy agentic workflows using Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tooling

Design RAG pipelines over product catalog, reviews, and parenting content

Wire LLM features into real customer touchpoints across WhatsApp, web, and internal tools

Work with vector stores, evals, prompt iteration, and production observability

Own the full loop from prototype to deployed service

What we look for:

2 to 3 strong AI or LLM projects we can actually try or read (GitHub, live links, Loom)

Strong Python, comfort with APIs, basic cloud fluency (AWS or GCP)

Experience with at least one of: agent frameworks, RAG, fine-tuning, or evals

A “shipped over perfect” mindset

Bonus: Hackathon wins, open-source contributions, or published writeups of real projects.

Track B: AI-Native Product Intern

This is not a traditional PM internship. You’ll be an operator who uses AI as the default tool for everything.

Expect to:

Define problems worth solving, then ship prototypes yourself using modern AI tooling before anyone writes production code

Run experiments against real user behavior on the Mumzworld app and WhatsApp

Work directly with engineering, design, and merchandising to spec and launch AI features

Own metrics, write crisp product docs, and drive decisions with data

Sit close to the customer, including shadowing support and talking to mothers directly

What we look for:

Evidence that you build, not just write. Show us a shipped side project, an AI prototype you coded yourself, a community you run, a bot you deployed, or a product you led end to end

Sharp written thinking. We’ll ask you to write, a lot

Fluency with modern AI tools as part of your everyday workflow

Comfort with ambiguity and strong product intuition

Bonus: E-commerce, consumer, or marketplace experience. Arabic or any MENA context is a plus but not required.

Real problems you could own:

The Mumz Assistant. An AI concierge that understands product safety, age-compatibility, and gifting context. Target: cut support tickets by 40 percent.

WhatsApp Personal Shopper. A chat-first AI sales assistant that helps a busy mom find the right car seat, stroller, or formula in under two minutes.

Smart Merchandising Copilot. Auto-generate and localize product descriptions in English and Arabic, at catalog scale, with quality guardrails.

Returns Intelligence. A model that predicts high-risk returns before checkout so we can intervene, saving millions in reverse logistics.

How We Work With AI

We’re pragmatic about tools. Use whatever gets you to a working system fastest, whether that’s the latest frontier models, open-source where it fits, or agent frameworks when they earn their place.

What matters is that you’re fluent with modern AI tooling as part of your daily workflow and can pick up new tools quickly. Our stack will evolve, and we expect you to help shape it.

How to apply:

Send us:

Three things you’ve built. Links to repos, Loom walkthroughs, deployed demos, or internal tools. For each one, one line on what it does and one line on what you learned.

Your pick. Track A (Engineering) or Track B (Product). Both is fine if you’ve got receipts.

A short note. “If I joined Mumzworld, the one AI feature I’d build to make a mother’s life easier is and how I’d approach it.”

Selection process

We prioritize builders, so the process is practical. Shortlisted candidates complete a scoped take-home challenge, roughly 3 to 5 hours, focused on a specific Mumzworld use case (for example, a Baby Shower Gift Finder). You’ll then review your build with our technical lead and get direct feedback.

Stipend is calibrated to the level of work you demonstrated, not your years of experience.

What You’ll Get

Ownership of real production work, not a training-wheels project. Code and product decisions that reach millions of parents across MENA. A fast path to a full-time AI or Product role at Mumzworld for the interns who show up and ship.

Why Mumzworld

Most internships give you tasks. We give you the chance to shape how an entire region’s parents shop, decide, and discover.

You won’t just learn AI here. You’ll ship it.

title: Data Testing Automation Engineer
description:

Design, develop, and maintain Python‑based automation frameworks, primarily using Pytest and FastAPI.

Continuously enhance and optimize test frameworks to improve efficiency, reliability, and scalability.

Requirements

5+ years of experience in QA and automation testing.
 
 
Strong expertise in Python, with solid understanding of OOP concepts.

Strong knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Git, and creating/managing Git jobs.
 
 
Solid understanding of SDLC and Agile methodologies.
 
 
Working knowledge of AWS environments.
 
 
Experience using JIRA for defect tracking and project management.
 
 
SQL skills and experience with database validation are preferred.
 
 
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem‑solving abilities.
 
 
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
 
 
Familiarity with AI‑powered tools is an added advantage.

Essential

Bachelors / BE / Btech in Computer Science, Information Technology , Data Analytics, AI and Machine learning from reputed university.

Excellent Software engineering fundamentals

Passion to drive their own career and willingness to learn.

Keen interest in the Aerospace industry

Exhibits leadership potential and ownership

Self-driven individual who can expand his/her skills with on-job training

Knowledge of any programing languages

Right to work in country that you have applied for

Desirable

Good knowledge of languages like Python, HTML, JS, CSS etc.

Good knowledge in the area of data science & industrial automations

Experience in creating ETL pipelines, BI dashboards, AI, ML, LLM, Machine Vision, Full stack software development (Python) etc. through internships, projects, competitions, self-interest etc.

Has undergone relevant courses or acquired knowledge and interest in areas related to software development, testing, deployment, Data Analytics, Data science, AI, ML, LLM, Machine Vision, Databases , SQL etc.

Self-driven individual who can expand his/her skills with on-job training to grow in digital areas.

We’ll offer you fantastic challenges and amazing opportunities. This is your chance to be part of an organisation that has proven itself to be at the cutting edge of our industry; and is committed to pushing the boundaries even further. And with some of the best training on offer in the industry, who knows how far you can go?

A Great Place to work needs a Great Way of Working

title: Researcher Trainee
description:
About HireRight

At HireRight, we empower organizations around the world to hire with precision and act with confidence. As a global leader in background screening and workforce intelligence aggregator, we combine smart technology, human expertise, and a passion for delivering with speed and accuracy to create a smooth experience for both employers and candidates. Headquartered in Nashville, TN, and operating in over 200 countries and territories, we’re proud to help millions of people get hired — the right way

Overview

If you’re a recent graduate looking to launch your career in a professional, fast-paced global organization — this is the perfect place to start.

As a Researcher Trainee, you’ll play an important part in helping people get hired by verifying key information in their background checks. Think of it as detective work with purpose — you’ll research, verify, and communicate. You’ll work closely with candidates, vendors and teams across the world to ensure reports are accurate, complete, and delivered on time.

This is an exciting opportunity to learn about global hiring practices, develop strong communication and research skills, and grow within a supportive, team-oriented environment.

Responsibilities

Below will be the primary responsibility of this role:

 Verify candidates’ information such as education and employment details using phone, email, and online research tools. 

 Communicate confidently and professionally with candidates to collect or clarify details, helping them move smoothly through the screening process. 

 Collaborate with internal teams to ensure timely and high-quality results for our clients. 

 Maintain accurate records and documentation in line with company standards. 

 Manage data with accuracy, confidentiality, and attention to detail. 

 Meet productivity and quality goals while learning continuously from feedback and training. 

 Contribute to process improvement by sharing ideas and best practices. 

 Support teammates and participate in a culture that values accuracy, teamwork, and customer focus. 

Qualifications

 A bachelor’s degree in any field — fresh graduates are welcome! 

 Strong communication skills in English (both written and verbal). 

 Basic computer knowledge — proficiency with Microsoft Office and email is a plus. 

 Detail-oriented mindset — you enjoy researching, checking facts, and ensuring accuracy. 

 Friendly and professional phone etiquette — comfortable reaching out to people. 

 Willingness to learn and grow in a flexible shift schedule. 

Previous customer service experience is an advantage but not required.

What Do We Offer

 You will play a role where your work truly impacts people’s careers worldwide. 

 Be part of a global organization that values learning, diversity, and collaboration. 

 Access AI & latest technology-driven, modern training programs to accelerate your learning. 

 Develop skills in communication, data verification, and client service that open doors to future career growth. 

 Work in an environment that’s supportive, inclusive, and focused on helping people succeed & grow. 

 Explore Internal Job Movement Opportunities to grow your career across different teams, functions, or global locations — your career path is not limited to one role. 

 Be part of a fun, vibrant & energetic community that knows to work hard & party harder. 

 Enjoy a comprehensive medical insurance plan to keep you and your family protected. 

 Benefit from a referral bonus program — earn rewards for bringing great talent into the company. 

 A transparent and supportive leave policy that helps you balance work and personal life. 

At HireRight, every check you complete helps someone take the next step in their career — including you.

title: CVAT Annotation Intern
description:
About Origin

Origin (previously 10xConstruction) is building general-purpose autonomous robots for US construction to tackle rising costs, safety risks, and labour shortages. Our modular, multi-trade platform combines purpose-built hardware with real-time site intelligence to navigate complex environments and execute tasks with precision. Trained in high-fidelity simulation and already deployed on live sites, our robots deliver 5x faster execution, 250%+ margin expansion, and significant cost savings. Join India's most talent-dense robotics team consisting of individuals from IITs, Stanford, UCLA, etc.

About The Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and motivated CVAT Annotation Intern to assist in the creation of high-quality label datasets using CVAT (Computer Vision Annotation Tool). In this role you will directly contribute to the creation of robust datasets required for training physical AI agents.

Key Responsibilities

Accurately annotate and label objects, regions, and features within images using various annotation techniques (e.g., bounding boxes, polygons, segmentation mask) on CVAT. Maintain organized records and document all annotation updates accurately. 

Perform quality control checks on annotated data, including reviewing and verifying the work of other annotators when required. 

Collaborate with AI/ML teams to enhance dataset quality and build new types of datasets. 

Suggest improvements to annotation guidelines and workflows. Adhere to project deadlines and deliver high-quality annotated data within predetermined timelines. 

Communicate effectively with project leads and team members about challenges and gather/share best practices

Requirements

Practical experience with data annotation for real-world AI applications. Master various image annotation techniques and become proficient in industry-standard human-in-the-loop annotation workflows. 

Gain expertise in CVAT, a leading annotation tool used across robotics and computer vision industries. 

Receive mentorship from experienced AI/ML professionals. 

Access a pathway to roles in data analysis, QA, or other entry-level positions within the AI and tech industries. 

For apprentice/Intern : 

This is a six-month contract-to-hire position, with potential for longer-term opportunities depending on your contributions and interests. We're excited to work with motivated individuals who are eager to support real-world robot development and grow alongside us.

Job Responsibilities

The Trainee in the Data Platform & BI CoE will work at the intersection of business, data engineering, and analytics. This role is designed for someone who naturally understands business problems, asks the right questions, and enjoys converting ambiguous needs into clear technical requirements. This role will have natural affinity for documentation, customer support and communication in the data ecosystem.

You will gain hands-on exposure to data engineering concepts, databases, SQL, cloud platforms, data lakes, data warehouses, and enterprise reporting. You will support the creation of governed, scalable, and high‑quality BI solutions used across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

 Business Analysis & Stakeholder Collaboration

Engage with business teams to translate problems into structured use cases, KPIs, dimensions, metrics, and acceptance criteria.

Document business requirements, process flows, user stories, and functional specifications, wire-frames.

Serve as a bridge between business users, data engineers, and BI developers.

 Platform Maintenance, Documentation & Community Championship

Assist in routine checks of Power BI workspaces, Databricks repos/catalog entries, and shared semantic models.

Contribute to CoE playbooks, templates, and standards, training materials.

Build a strong community and host training sessions.

 BI Development & Reporting (Supervised)

Assist in building Power BI reports using solid fundamentals of semantic modeling (dimensions/facts/star schema).

Maintain Power BI Tenant.

Write intermediate SQL for querying and validating datasets.

Implement standardized visuals, DAX measures, RLS/OLS, and follow BI CoE design guidelines.

 Cloud & Platform Awareness

Develop a working understanding of cloud concepts (compute, storage, networking basics, IAM, scalability).

Familiarity with platforms like Azure, Databricks, SQL Warehouse, Fabric, or equivalent is preferred.

Support activities around deployment, workspace structures, ABAC/RBAC policies, and platform governance.

 Testing, UAT & Adoption Support

Prepare test scenarios, UAT cases, and validate end-to-end functionality.

Assist with change management, enablement sessions, and documentation for business users.

Track adoption, gather feedback, and help refine dashboards and KPIs.

Must-Have Skills

Strong natural curiosity and ability to break down business problems logically.

Intermediate knowledge of SQL (joins, aggregations, window functions preferred).

Basic knowledge of data engineering concepts (pipelines, transformations, medallion/layered architecture).

Understanding of cloud fundamentals (compute, storage, IAM, security).

Working knowledge of Power BI or another BI tool (data model, Power Query, visuals).

Strong documentation skills (BRD/PRD, user stories, data dictionary).

Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

Nice-to-Have Skills

Exposure to Databricks, Unity Catalog, Fabric, or enterprise data platforms.

Basic DAX knowledge and understanding of semantic modeling.

Familiarity with Agile methodology, Jira/Azure Boards.

Knowledge of data quality checks, SLA concepts, and data contracts.

Basic statistics (trends, distributions).

title: LEAD Engineering
description:
Job Description

It’s not just about your career or job title… It’s about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it’s for each other or our customers, we put People First. When our people come together, we Expand the Possible and continuously look for ways to improve what we create and how we do it. If you are constantly striving to grow, you’re in good company. We are revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations, and we want someone who is ready to move with us.

Who are we? 

Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems.

Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more!

Role Summary

Wabtec’s Leadership Expertise & Accelerated Development (LEAD) is a prestigious program for young professionals who have a passion for technology, a drive for excellence, and share in Wabtec’s core values. The program is designed to accelerate participants' professional development through intense technical training and a variety of business-critical assignments. LEAD graduates have proven to be the vanguards of technical and business excellence and have track record of proactively and continually making innovative contributions to Wabtec’s future.

Essential Responsibilities

Over the course of the program, you’ll receive a broad set of diverse assignments spanning

product management, data analytics, IT operations, software development, and more.

Additional Responsibilities

Full-time, two-year leadership development program where members work within the WABTEC business alongside experts in various locations.

Four, six months rotational assignments within your specific business covering diverse projects in Digital Engineering, Data Analytics & Operations, Technical Product Management, and more.

Global classroom experience and virtual coursework focused on technical training, leadership, and business acumen.

Qualifications/Requirements

Basic Qualifications

A Bachelor’s/ Master’s Degree in Computer Science, CIS, Computer Engineering, Electronics and Communications Engineering, IT Security, ITM, Informatics, Information Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, MIS, Security and Risk Analysis or relevant STEM majors with experience in Software or IT experience; or graduate of a software/IT accelerator program.

Minimum cumulative 8 CGPA.

Graduating by May/June 2026.

Eligibility Requirements

Legal authorization to work in the India is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job.

Desired Characteristics

Strong analytical skills.

A strong commitment to a career in technology with a passion and aptitude for both software and information technology.

Up to date with current industry standards, trending software, and information technology development tools.

Preferred strong knowledge in concepts of OOPS, Data Structure and Algorithms, strong hold in any programming language e.g. Java, C++, C#. Knowledge of Test Automation, Web Application development, DevOps, Data Analytics/Machine Learning, Cloud Computing will be preferred.

Prior intern, co-op, or research experience in IT, software, or relevant area.

Solves technical challenges through regular application of common design patterns, and identify appropriate patterns for use in problem solving. Applies strong analytical mindset to solve complex problems with an innovative and out-of-the-box thinking.

Ability to understand coding standards that meet and deliver desired functionality using the technology selected for the project.

Strong customer focus, ability to understand the value proposition for the customer, and commitment to deliver the best value proposition.

Able to engage positively across multiple departments to establish clarity, vision, and mutual trust to achieve business goals.

Demonstrated program / project management skills working on and leading teams.

Leadership experience inside and/or outside the classroom.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to articulate technical problems in clear and simple terms.

Contributes to creative solutions and challenges the status quo.

Proactively learns new tools and identifies opportunities for improvement and promotes their adoption.

About Us

Come join us as we continue to deliver the exceptional products and services our customers

expect. Our employees are our greatest asset, and we look forward to a bright future within

Wabtec. WABTEC offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging

careers, and competitive compensation. WABTEC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Location: Bengaluru, India

Our Commitment To Embrace Diversity

Wabtec is a global company that invests not just in our products, but also our people by embracing diversity and inclusion. We care about our relationships with our employees and take pride in celebrating the variety of experiences, expertise, and backgrounds that bring us together. At Wabtec, we aspire to create a place where we all belong and where diversity is welcomed and appreciated.

To fulfill that commitment, we rely on a culture of leadership, diversity, and inclusion. We aim to employ the world’s brightest minds to help us create a limitless source of ideas and opportunities. We have created a space where everyone is given the opportunity to contribute based on their individual experiences and perspectives and recognize that these differences and diverse perspectives make us better.

We believe in hiring talented people of varied backgrounds, experiences, and styles… People like you! Wabtec Corporation is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or protected Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Additional Information

What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Who are we?

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

Culture powers us and the possibilities.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.

We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more.

Need accommodation? Just let us know - we’ve got you.

title: Intern - CEO's Office
description:
Job Description

About the role

This isn't a passive, observation-only internship. You'll be embedded at the center of business and operations, acting as a key analytical support to the CEO. You'll gather, structure, and surface information that directly shapes how the company moves — and you'll be expected to take ownership of making things happen, not just report on them.

What You'll Do

Work directly with the CEO to track strategic priorities, business metrics, and operational initiatives

Gather, clean, and organize data from multiple sources — internal tools, spreadsheets, surveys, and operational feeds

Build and maintain dashboards and reports that give leadership a real-time pulse on key metrics

Prepare crisp, well-structured briefs, summaries, and decks for CEO-level reviews and meetings

Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities in data and present findings with clear, actionable recommendations

Support operations by tracking workflows, flagging bottlenecks, and driving process improvements

Coordinate across teams on behalf of the CEO's office — follow up on deliverables and keep initiatives on track

Own small projects end-to-end — from scoping and data collection to analysis and presenting results

Must-haves

Strong working knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets (pivot tables, formulas, basic modelling)

Excellent written and verbal communication — you can distill complexity into clarity

Comfort in the room with senior leaders — you're confident, not intimidated

High ownership mindset — you follow through without being chased

Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Engineering, Business, Economics, Statistics, or a related field

What we're really looking for

Go-getter

You move fast, ask good questions, and don't let blockers sit.

Business-aware

You understand that data exists to drive decisions, not fill slides.

CEO-ready

Discreet, dependable, and sharp enough to work at the top floor.

Driver, not passenger

You take initiative and push activities to completion.
